texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
林林和天天是同学。天天的父母要出差，想请我们帮忙照看几天女儿，我和老公爽快地答应下来，有个孩子和我们的独生女朝夕相处，我们巴不得呢！最兴奋的是林林，嚷着要用爸爸最拿手的美味佳肴欢迎天天来我家，还提出，她的书桌可以和天天共用。看到女儿对伙伴热情无私，我和老公别提多高兴了。
天天还没来，林林就变得异常勤劳，将屋子收拾得干干净净，东西摆放得整整齐齐，什么好事都想着天天。我家林林虽是女孩，却也绅士风度十足。
天天的到来，使我和老公的日子过得异常省心。两个孩子每天早上不用叫就醒了，上学不用接送，做作业不用督促；她们不打架，不闹别扭，关系别提多融洽了。看到女儿和天天这么亲密，大有忽略我们的趋势，我和老公都有点儿嫉妒了。
这天晚上，两个孩子做完作业，开始滔滔不绝地聊了起来，一个说，我不喜欢王朵朵，她就喜欢跟穿得漂亮的同学一起玩儿，还老嘲笑别人。另一个说我讨厌高春来，他最会讨好老师了……
我和老公对视一眼，这么小的孩子怎么学会了背后议论人。我郑重地走到她们跟前，严肃地说：“看到别人有缺点，应该当面说，背后说人家的坏话不好。”老公也在旁边附和：“大伙儿要和睦相处，对人要宽容。”女儿却是一脸的疑惑，反问道：“你们不是也有时候说，哪个朋友好相处，哪个朋友很自私吗？”瞬间我和老公被问得说不出话来，屋子里鸦雀无声。
人们常说，启蒙老师的重要性不可忽视，父母就是孩子的第一任老师，这话确实不假，可如果这次不是女儿反驳，我还意识不到，我们自己的做法和对孩子的要求实行的是两套标准，那便是对自己宽容，对孩子严厉。孩子也可以是我们的老师啊。
说真的，这次是孩子给我上了一课：我深深地感到，想当好父母，首先要约束好自己的言行。

lines.zh: 林林和天天是同学。天天的父母要出差，想请我们帮忙照看几天女儿，我和老公爽快地答应下来，有个孩子和我们的独生女朝夕相处，我们巴不得呢！最兴奋的是林林，嚷着要用爸爸最拿手的美味佳肴欢迎天天来我家，还提出，她的书桌可以和天天共用。看到女儿对伙伴热情无私，我和老公别提多高兴了。
lines.py: Línlín hé Tiāntiān shì tóngxué. Tiāntiān de fùmǔ yào chūchāi, xiǎng qǐng wǒmen bāngmáng zhàokàn jǐ tiān nǚ'ér, wǒ hé lǎogōng shuǎngkuai de dāying xialai, yǒu ge háizi hé wǒmen de dúshēngnǚ zhāoxī xiāngchǔ, wǒmen bā bu de ne! Zuì xīngfèn de shì Línlín, rǎngzhe yào yòng bàba zuì náshǒu de měiwèi jiāyáo huānyíng Tiāntiān lái wǒ jiā, hái tíchū, tā de shūzhuō kěyǐ hé Tiāntiān gòngyòng. Kàndào nǚ'ér duì huǒbàn rèqíng wúsī, wǒ hé lǎogōng biétí duō gāoxìng le.
lines.en: Linlin and Tiantian are classmates. Tiantian's parents had to go on a business trip and wanted us to look after their daughter for a few days, and my husband and I readily agreed—having a child spend day and night with our only daughter was exactly what we wished for! The most excited was Linlin, who clamored to welcome Tiantian to our home with her dad's best signature dishes, and even offered to share her desk with Tiantian. Seeing our daughter so warm and selfless toward her friend, my husband and I couldn't have been happier.

lines.zh: 天天还没来，林林就变得异常勤劳，将屋子收拾得干干净净，东西摆放得整整齐齐，什么好事都想着天天。我家林林虽是女孩，却也绅士风度十足。
lines.py: Tiāntiān hái méi lái, Línlín jiù biàn de yìcháng qínláo, jiāng wūzi shōushi de gāngān jìngjìng, dōngxi bǎifàng de zhěngzhěng qíqí, shénme hǎo shì dōu xiǎngzhe Tiāntiān. Wǒ jiā Línlín suī shì nǚhái, què yě shēnshì fēngdù shízú.
lines.en: Before Tiantian had even arrived, Linlin became unusually hardworking: she tidied the room until it was spotless and arranged everything neatly, and whatever good thing there was, she thought of Tiantian first. Although our Linlin is a girl, she was a perfect gentleman.

lines.zh: 天天的到来，使我和老公的日子过得异常省心。两个孩子每天早上不用叫就醒了，上学不用接送，做作业不用督促；她们不打架，不闹别扭，关系别提多融洽了。看到女儿和天天这么亲密，大有忽略我们的趋势，我和老公都有点儿嫉妒了。
lines.py: Tiāntiān de dàolái, shǐ wǒ hé lǎogōng de rìzi guò de yìcháng shěngxīn. Liǎng ge háizi měi tiān zǎoshang bú yòng jiào jiù xǐng le, shàngxué bú yòng jiēsòng, zuò zuòyè bú yòng dūcù; tāmen bù dǎjià, bú nào bièniu, guānxi biétí duō róngqià le. Kàndào nǚ'ér hé Tiāntiān zhème qīnmì, dà yǒu hūlüè wǒmen de qūshì, wǒ hé lǎogōng dōu yǒudiǎnr jídù le.
lines.en: Tiantian's arrival made life remarkably worry-free for my husband and me. The two children woke up every morning without being called, didn't need to be taken to and from school, and didn't need to be pushed to do their homework; they didn't fight or sulk, and got along wonderfully. Seeing our daughter so close to Tiantian that she seemed well on her way to ignoring us, my husband and I both got a little jealous.

lines.zh: 这天晚上，两个孩子做完作业，开始滔滔不绝地聊了起来，一个说，我不喜欢王朵朵，她就喜欢跟穿得漂亮的同学一起玩儿，还老嘲笑别人。另一个说我讨厌高春来，他最会讨好老师了……
lines.py: Zhè tiān wǎnshang, liǎng ge háizi zuòwán zuòyè, kāishǐ tāotāo bù jué de liáo le qilai, yí ge shuō, wǒ bù xǐhuan Wáng Duǒduo, tā jiù xǐhuan gēn chuān de piàoliang de tóngxué yìqǐ wánr, hái lǎo cháoxiào biérén. Lìng yí ge shuō wǒ tǎoyàn Gāo Chūnlái, tā zuì huì tǎohǎo lǎoshī le……
lines.en: That evening, after finishing their homework, the two children began chatting nonstop. One said, I don't like Wang Duoduo—she only likes playing with classmates who dress nicely, and she's always making fun of others. The other said, I can't stand Gao Chunlai—he's the best at sucking up to the teacher...

lines.zh: 我和老公对视一眼，这么小的孩子怎么学会了背后议论人。我郑重地走到她们跟前，严肃地说：“看到别人有缺点，应该当面说，背后说人家的坏话不好。”老公也在旁边附和：“大伙儿要和睦相处，对人要宽容。”女儿却是一脸的疑惑，反问道：“你们不是也有时候说，哪个朋友好相处，哪个朋友很自私吗？”瞬间我和老公被问得说不出话来，屋子里鸦雀无声。
lines.py: Wǒ hé lǎogōng duìshì yì yǎn, zhème xiǎo de háizi zěnme xuéhuì le bèihòu yìlùn rén. Wǒ zhèngzhòng de zǒudào tāmen gēnqián, yánsù de shuō: "Kàndào biérén yǒu quēdiǎn, yīnggāi dāngmiàn shuō, bèihòu shuō rénjia de huàihuà bù hǎo." Lǎogōng yě zài pángbiān fùhè: "Dàhuǒr yào hémù xiāngchǔ, duì rén yào kuānróng." Nǚ'ér què shì yì liǎn de yíhuò, fǎnwèn dào: "Nǐmen bú shì yě yǒu shíhou shuō, nǎge péngyou hǎo xiāngchǔ, nǎge péngyou hěn zìsī ma?" Shùnjiān wǒ hé lǎogōng bèi wèn de shuō bu chū huà lai, wūzi li yāquè wú shēng.
lines.en: My husband and I exchanged a glance—how had such young children learned to talk about people behind their backs? I walked over to them solemnly and said seriously, "If you see that someone has a fault, you should tell them to their face; speaking ill of people behind their backs isn't nice." My husband chimed in beside me: "Everyone should get along in harmony and be tolerant of others." But our daughter looked puzzled and asked back, "Don't you sometimes say too which friend is easy to get along with and which friend is selfish?" In an instant my husband and I were left speechless, and the room fell completely silent.

lines.zh: 人们常说，启蒙老师的重要性不可忽视，父母就是孩子的第一任老师，这话确实不假，可如果这次不是女儿反驳，我还意识不到，我们自己的做法和对孩子的要求实行的是两套标准，那便是对自己宽容，对孩子严厉。孩子也可以是我们的老师啊。
lines.py: Rénmen cháng shuō, qǐméng lǎoshī de zhòngyàoxìng bùkě hūshì, fùmǔ jiù shì háizi de dì-yī rèn lǎoshī, zhè huà quèshí bù jiǎ, kě rúguǒ zhè cì bú shì nǚ'ér fǎnbó, wǒ hái yìshí bu dào, wǒmen zìjǐ de zuòfǎ hé duì háizi de yāoqiú shíxíng de shì liǎng tào biāozhǔn, nà biàn shì duì zìjǐ kuānróng, duì háizi yánlì. Háizi yě kěyǐ shì wǒmen de lǎoshī a.
lines.en: People often say that the importance of one's first teacher can't be overlooked, and that parents are a child's first teachers. That's certainly true, but if my daughter hadn't talked back this time, I still wouldn't have realized that we were applying two sets of standards—one for our own behavior and another for what we demanded of our child: lenient with ourselves, strict with her. Children can be our teachers too.

lines.zh: 说真的，这次是孩子给我上了一课：我深深地感到，想当好父母，首先要约束好自己的言行。
lines.py: Shuō zhēn de, zhè cì shì háizi gěi wǒ shàng le yí kè: wǒ shēnshēn de gǎndào, xiǎng dānghǎo fùmǔ, shǒuxiān yào yuēshù hǎo zìjǐ de yánxíng.
lines.en: To be honest, this time it was my child who taught me a lesson: I deeply felt that to be good parents, we must first keep our own words and actions in check.

sentences.text: 林林和天天是同学。
看到女儿对伙伴热情无私，我和老公别提多高兴了。
我家林林虽是女孩，却也绅士风度十足。
天天的到来，使我和老公的日子过得异常省心。
她们不打架，不闹别扭，关系别提多融洽了。
另一个说我讨厌高春来，他最会讨好老师了……
老公也在旁边附和：“大伙儿要和睦相处，对人要宽容。”
瞬间我和老公被问得说不出话来，屋子里鸦雀无声。
孩子也可以是我们的老师啊。

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
我从小生活在一个有爱的家庭，父母感情和睦，很少吵架，他们对我态度和蔼，说话和气，目光中都充满着慈祥。他们和我身边所有父母一样，给我很多宠爱，我也和身边所有的孩子一样，在跨进大学校门之前，从没有离开过家，独立自主的能力就更甭提了。脱离父母，独立生活对我具有巨大的诱惑，让我无比向往。
几年以后，我终于在别的城市上了大学。第一次离开家，心里的孤独感一下子跑了出来。记得刚开学的时候，宿舍里的同学一给家里打电话就哭鼻子，每到节假日，大家更是片刻不停地往家赶。有同学回趟家要坐一夜的火车，这也阻挡不了大家回家的步伐。回家的快乐和被亲情包围的幸福感染了我，我也恨不得马上飞到父母跟前，与他们团圆。
假期终于要到了，我给父母打电话，告诉他们我准备回家。母亲却说，近来他们比较忙，要没什么事，就甭回来了，在学校看看书，或找份兼职做做。母亲的话使我酝酿已久的恋家情绪刹那间就没有了，我无法理解父母的反常，心中暗暗埋怨父母不体谅我。无精打采了几天之后，我不得不开始规划怎样熬过漫长的假期。
假期的校园寂静得很，我在图书馆看书，给杂志社写稿件，发现在难得的寂静中工作是那么美好。
大学三年级，我回了趟家。母亲第一眼看到我时，脸上满是心疼，但瞬间那情绪就被她掩饰起来，我心中飞快地闪过一丝疑惑：他们在隐瞒什么呢？
那晚，我躺下怎么也睡不着，半夜听到母亲还在跟父亲唠叨：“孩子比在家时瘦多了，肯定是吃苦了，可她的变化还是挺让咱们欣慰的。”接着是父亲的声音：“总有一天她会明白的，不吃苦，怎么长本事？社会不需要只会享福的人。”
我悄悄走出卧室，看到灯光下父母不舍的目光、头上新增的白发和眼角越来越深的皱纹，顿时什么都明白了，不由得热泪盈眶。

lines.zh: 我从小生活在一个有爱的家庭，父母感情和睦，很少吵架，他们对我态度和蔼，说话和气，目光中都充满着慈祥。他们和我身边所有父母一样，给我很多宠爱，我也和身边所有的孩子一样，在跨进大学校门之前，从没有离开过家，独立自主的能力就更甭提了。脱离父母，独立生活对我具有巨大的诱惑，让我无比向往。
lines.py: Wǒ cóngxiǎo shēnghuó zài yí ge yǒu ài de jiātíng, fùmǔ gǎnqíng hémù, hěn shǎo chǎojià, tāmen duì wǒ tàidu hé'ǎi, shuōhuà héqi, mùguāng zhōng dōu chōngmǎnzhe cíxiáng. Tāmen hé wǒ shēnbiān suǒyǒu fùmǔ yíyàng, gěi wǒ hěn duō chǒng'ài, wǒ yě hé shēnbiān suǒyǒu de háizi yíyàng, zài kuàjìn dàxué xiàomén zhīqián, cóng méiyǒu líkāi guo jiā, dúlì zìzhǔ de nénglì jiù gèng béng tí le. Tuōlí fùmǔ, dúlì shēnghuó duì wǒ jùyǒu jùdà de yòuhuò, ràng wǒ wúbǐ xiàngwǎng.
lines.en: I grew up in a loving family. My parents got along well and rarely quarreled; they were kind to me, spoke gently, and their eyes were always full of affection. Like all the parents around me, they doted on me, and like all the children around me, I had never left home before stepping through the university gates—let alone had any ability to be independent. Leaving my parents and living on my own held an enormous attraction for me, and I longed for it more than anything.

lines.zh: 几年以后，我终于在别的城市上了大学。第一次离开家，心里的孤独感一下子跑了出来。记得刚开学的时候，宿舍里的同学一给家里打电话就哭鼻子，每到节假日，大家更是片刻不停地往家赶。有同学回趟家要坐一夜的火车，这也阻挡不了大家回家的步伐。回家的快乐和被亲情包围的幸福感染了我，我也恨不得马上飞到父母跟前，与他们团圆。
lines.py: Jǐ nián yǐhòu, wǒ zhōngyú zài bié de chéngshì shàng le dàxué. Dì-yī cì líkāi jiā, xīnli de gūdúgǎn yíxiàzi pǎo le chūlai. Jìde gāng kāixué de shíhou, sùshè li de tóngxué yì gěi jiāli dǎ diànhuà jiù kū bízi, měi dào jiéjiàrì, dàjiā gèng shì piànkè bù tíng de wǎng jiā gǎn. Yǒu tóngxué huí tàng jiā yào zuò yí yè de huǒchē, zhè yě zǔdǎng bu liǎo dàjiā huí jiā de bùfá. Huí jiā de kuàilè hé bèi qīnqíng bāowéi de xìngfú gǎnrǎn le wǒ, wǒ yě hèn bu de mǎshàng fēidào fùmǔ gēnqián, yǔ tāmen tuányuán.
lines.en: A few years later, I finally went to university in another city. It was my first time away from home, and a sense of loneliness suddenly surfaced in my heart. I remember that when term had just begun, my dormmates would cry as soon as they called home, and at every holiday everyone rushed home without a moment's pause. Some classmates had to take an overnight train to get home, but even that couldn't stop them. The joy of going home and the happiness of being surrounded by family love rubbed off on me, and I too wished I could fly straight to my parents and be reunited with them.

lines.zh: 假期终于要到了，我给父母打电话，告诉他们我准备回家。母亲却说，近来他们比较忙，要没什么事，就甭回来了，在学校看看书，或找份兼职做做。母亲的话使我酝酿已久的恋家情绪刹那间就没有了，我无法理解父母的反常，心中暗暗埋怨父母不体谅我。无精打采了几天之后，我不得不开始规划怎样熬过漫长的假期。
lines.py: Jiàqī zhōngyú yào dào le, wǒ gěi fùmǔ dǎ diànhuà, gàosu tāmen wǒ zhǔnbèi huí jiā. Mǔqīn què shuō, jìnlái tāmen bǐjiào máng, yào méi shénme shì, jiù béng huílai le, zài xuéxiào kànkan shū, huò zhǎo fèn jiānzhí zuòzuo. Mǔqīn de huà shǐ wǒ yùnniàng yǐ jiǔ de liàn jiā qíngxù chànà jiān jiù méiyǒu le, wǒ wúfǎ lǐjiě fùmǔ de fǎncháng, xīnzhōng àn'àn mányuàn fùmǔ bù tǐliàng wǒ. Wújīng dǎcǎi le jǐ tiān zhīhòu, wǒ bùdébù kāishǐ guīhuà zěnyàng áoguò màncháng de jiàqī.
lines.en: The holidays were finally coming, so I called my parents to tell them I was planning to come home. But my mother said they had been rather busy lately, and if there was nothing in particular, I needn't come back—I could read at school or find a part-time job. Her words instantly wiped out the homesickness that had been building in me for so long. I couldn't understand my parents' unusual behavior and secretly blamed them for not being considerate of me. After moping around for a few days, I had no choice but to start planning how to get through the long vacation.

lines.zh: 假期的校园寂静得很，我在图书馆看书，给杂志社写稿件，发现在难得的寂静中工作是那么美好。
lines.py: Jiàqī de xiàoyuán jìjìng de hěn, wǒ zài túshūguǎn kàn shū, gěi zázhìshè xiě gǎojiàn, fāxiàn zài nándé de jìjìng zhōng gōngzuò shì nàme měihǎo.
lines.en: The campus during the holidays was very quiet. I read in the library and wrote articles for magazines, and discovered how wonderful it was to work in such rare quiet.

lines.zh: 大学三年级，我回了趟家。母亲第一眼看到我时，脸上满是心疼，但瞬间那情绪就被她掩饰起来，我心中飞快地闪过一丝疑惑：他们在隐瞒什么呢？
lines.py: Dàxué sān niánjí, wǒ huí le tàng jiā. Mǔqīn dì-yī yǎn kàndào wǒ shí, liǎn shang mǎn shì xīnténg, dàn shùnjiān nà qíngxù jiù bèi tā yǎnshì qilai, wǒ xīnzhōng fēikuài de shǎnguò yì sī yíhuò: tāmen zài yǐnmán shénme ne?
lines.en: In my third year of university, I went home once. When my mother first saw me, her face was full of heartache, but in an instant she hid the feeling. A flicker of doubt shot through my mind: what were they hiding?

lines.zh: 那晚，我躺下怎么也睡不着，半夜听到母亲还在跟父亲唠叨：“孩子比在家时瘦多了，肯定是吃苦了，可她的变化还是挺让咱们欣慰的。”接着是父亲的声音：“总有一天她会明白的，不吃苦，怎么长本事？社会不需要只会享福的人。”
lines.py: Nà wǎn, wǒ tǎngxia zěnme yě shuì bu zháo, bànyè tīngdào mǔqīn hái zài gēn fùqīn láodao: "Háizi bǐ zài jiā shí shòu duō le, kěndìng shì chīkǔ le, kě tā de biànhuà háishi tǐng ràng zánmen xīnwèi de." Jiēzhe shì fùqīn de shēngyīn: "Zǒng yǒu yì tiān tā huì míngbai de, bù chīkǔ, zěnme zhǎng běnshi? Shèhuì bù xūyào zhǐ huì xiǎngfú de rén."
lines.en: That night I lay down but couldn't fall asleep no matter what. In the middle of the night I heard my mother still talking to my father: "She's much thinner than when she was at home—she must have had a hard time. But the way she's changed is still quite a comfort to us." Then came my father's voice: "One day she'll understand. Without hardship, how can she gain real ability? Society doesn't need people who only know how to enjoy themselves."

lines.zh: 我悄悄走出卧室，看到灯光下父母不舍的目光、头上新增的白发和眼角越来越深的皱纹，顿时什么都明白了，不由得热泪盈眶。
lines.py: Wǒ qiāoqiāo zǒuchū wòshì, kàndào dēngguāng xia fùmǔ bù shě de mùguāng, tóu shang xīn zēng de báifà hé yǎnjiǎo yuè lái yuè shēn de zhòuwén, dùnshí shénme dōu míngbai le, bùyóude rèlèi yíng kuàng.
lines.en: I quietly stepped out of the bedroom. Seeing in the lamplight my parents' reluctant, loving gaze, the new white hairs on their heads, and the ever-deepening wrinkles at the corners of their eyes, I suddenly understood everything, and my eyes couldn't help filling with tears.

sentences.text: 脱离父母，独立生活对我具有巨大的诱惑，让我无比向往。
几年以后，我终于在别的城市上了大学。
第一次离开家，心里的孤独感一下子跑了出来。
假期终于要到了，我给父母打电话，告诉他们我准备回家。
无精打采了几天之后，我不得不开始规划怎样熬过漫长的假期。
大学三年级，我回了趟家。
社会不需要只会享福的人。”

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
清晨上班，走到公司楼下，迎面站着一位农民工模样的男人，他打量了我一番，到嘴边的话又不说了。我停住脚步，疑惑地问：“您有事吗？”他搓着手，迟疑地说：“有件事想拜托你。”
“您说吧，只要能帮的，我一定帮。”这回轮到我打量他了：饱经沧桑的脸上流露出朴实；一双过于操劳的大手；胡须起码一个星期没刮了；南方口音。
果然，他来自南方的一个乡镇，原先是裁缝，现在在我们旁边的港口干活。他女儿在上海，中秋节快到了，要给他寄盒月饼，可他白天在工地，地址没法写，想请我帮他代收一下。
“这个忙好帮，您不怕我把收到的月饼给吃了？”我半开玩笑地说。他笑着说：“不会，你和我女儿一样，斯斯文文的，一看就读过书，心眼儿好，守信誉，怎么会欺骗我呢？”他说女儿念了硕士，有学位，在一家一流的公司上班，是个主管，还有助手，怎么也算得上是公司的骨干。”说起女儿，他满脸的骄傲。
我记下了他的电话，给了他一张我的名片。他小心翼翼地收起来，满怀喜悦地走了。
第三天中午，我收到了一个重重的包裹，发件人叫“张心悦”。我马上拨打张师傅的电话，却无人接听，给他发短信，他也不回，直到下班，仍旧没有音信。
我心里隐约有些不安，抱着包裹就往工地跑，找了一位工人，请他帮忙找张师傅。一会儿，浑身汗水的张师傅来了。他见了我又是道歉又是感谢，说今天特别忙，手机没电了都不知道。说着就要拆包裹，非要请我吃月饼不可。我说家里什么馅儿的月饼都有，还是赶快给女儿打电话吧。
电话通了，张师傅满脸慈爱，笑得别提多灿烂了：“心心，月饼爸爸收到了，……我身体好着呢，别惦记，好好工作，别给爸爸丢人啊……”讲完电话，张师傅还没忘了向我炫耀他的女儿，“要面子着呢，从来没有辜负过我的期望。”
看得出，女儿是他的幸福。

lines.zh: 清晨上班，走到公司楼下，迎面站着一位农民工模样的男人，他打量了我一番，到嘴边的话又不说了。我停住脚步，疑惑地问：“您有事吗？”他搓着手，迟疑地说：“有件事想拜托你。”
lines.py: Qīngchén shàngbān, zǒudào gōngsī lóu xià, yíngmiàn zhànzhe yí wèi nóngmíngōng múyàng de nánrén, tā dǎliang le wǒ yì fān, dào zuǐ biān de huà yòu bù shuō le. Wǒ tíngzhù jiǎobù, yíhuò de wèn: "Nín yǒu shì ma?" Tā cuōzhe shǒu, chíyí de shuō: "Yǒu jiàn shì xiǎng bàituō nǐ."
lines.en: Early one morning on my way to work, as I reached the foot of our office building, a man who looked like a migrant worker was standing in front of me. He sized me up, then held back the words that were on the tip of his tongue. I stopped and asked, puzzled, "Can I help you?" Rubbing his hands, he said hesitantly, "There's something I'd like to ask you to do for me."

lines.zh: “您说吧，只要能帮的，我一定帮。”这回轮到我打量他了：饱经沧桑的脸上流露出朴实；一双过于操劳的大手；胡须起码一个星期没刮了；南方口音。
lines.py: "Nín shuō ba, zhǐyào néng bāng de, wǒ yídìng bāng." Zhè huí lúndào wǒ dǎliang tā le: bǎojīng cāngsāng de liǎn shang liúlù chū pǔshí; yì shuāng guòyú cāoláo de dà shǒu; húxū qǐmǎ yí ge xīngqī méi guā le; nánfāng kǒuyīn.
lines.en: "Go ahead—if I can help, I definitely will." This time it was my turn to size him up: a weather-beaten face that showed simplicity and honesty; a pair of big, overworked hands; a beard that hadn't been shaved for at least a week; a southern accent.

lines.zh: 果然，他来自南方的一个乡镇，原先是裁缝，现在在我们旁边的港口干活。他女儿在上海，中秋节快到了，要给他寄盒月饼，可他白天在工地，地址没法写，想请我帮他代收一下。
lines.py: Guǒrán, tā láizì nánfāng de yí ge xiāngzhèn, yuánxiān shì cáifeng, xiànzài zài wǒmen pángbiān de gǎngkǒu gànhuó. Tā nǚ'ér zài Shànghǎi, Zhōngqiū Jié kuài dào le, yào gěi tā jì hé yuèbing, kě tā báitiān zài gōngdì, dìzhǐ méifǎ xiě, xiǎng qǐng wǒ bāng tā dài shōu yíxià.
lines.en: Sure enough, he came from a small town in the south. He used to be a tailor and now worked at the port next to us. His daughter was in Shanghai, and with the Mid-Autumn Festival coming, she wanted to send him a box of mooncakes, but since he was at the construction site during the day, he had no address to give, so he wanted me to receive it on his behalf.

lines.zh: “这个忙好帮，您不怕我把收到的月饼给吃了？”我半开玩笑地说。他笑着说：“不会，你和我女儿一样，斯斯文文的，一看就读过书，心眼儿好，守信誉，怎么会欺骗我呢？”他说女儿念了硕士，有学位，在一家一流的公司上班，是个主管，还有助手，怎么也算得上是公司的骨干。”说起女儿，他满脸的骄傲。
lines.py: "Zhège máng hǎo bāng, nín bú pà wǒ bǎ shōudào de yuèbing gěi chī le?" Wǒ bàn kāi wánxiào de shuō. Tā xiàozhe shuō: "Bú huì, nǐ hé wǒ nǚ'ér yíyàng, sīsī wénwén de, yí kàn jiù dú guo shū, xīnyǎnr hǎo, shǒu xìnyù, zěnme huì qīpiàn wǒ ne?" Tā shuō nǚ'ér niàn le shuòshì, yǒu xuéwèi, zài yì jiā yīliú de gōngsī shàngbān, shì ge zhǔguǎn, hái yǒu zhùshǒu, zěnme yě suàn de shàng shì gōngsī de gǔgàn." Shuōqǐ nǚ'ér, tā mǎn liǎn de jiāo'ào.
lines.en: "That's an easy favor. Aren't you afraid I'll eat the mooncakes once I get them?" I said half-jokingly. He smiled and said, "No, you're just like my daughter—refined and gentle, obviously well educated, kind-hearted and trustworthy. How could you cheat me?" He said his daughter had a master's degree and worked at a first-class company as a manager, even with an assistant—she could definitely be counted as one of the company's mainstays." When he talked about his daughter, his face was full of pride.

lines.zh: 我记下了他的电话，给了他一张我的名片。他小心翼翼地收起来，满怀喜悦地走了。
lines.py: Wǒ jìxia le tā de diànhuà, gěi le tā yì zhāng wǒ de míngpiàn. Tā xiǎoxīn yìyì de shōu qilai, mǎnhuái xǐyuè de zǒu le.
lines.en: I wrote down his phone number and gave him one of my business cards. He put it away with great care and left full of joy.

lines.zh: 第三天中午，我收到了一个重重的包裹，发件人叫“张心悦”。我马上拨打张师傅的电话，却无人接听，给他发短信，他也不回，直到下班，仍旧没有音信。
lines.py: Dì-sān tiān zhōngwǔ, wǒ shōudào le yí ge zhòngzhòng de bāoguǒ, fājiànrén jiào "Zhāng Xīnyuè". Wǒ mǎshàng bōdǎ Zhāng shīfu de diànhuà, què wú rén jiētīng, gěi tā fā duǎnxìn, tā yě bù huí, zhídào xiàbān, réngjiù méiyǒu yīnxìn.
lines.en: At noon on the third day, I received a heavy package from a sender named "Zhang Xinyue". I immediately called Master Zhang, but no one answered; I texted him, but he didn't reply either, and by the time I got off work there was still no word from him.

lines.zh: 我心里隐约有些不安，抱着包裹就往工地跑，找了一位工人，请他帮忙找张师傅。一会儿，浑身汗水的张师傅来了。他见了我又是道歉又是感谢，说今天特别忙，手机没电了都不知道。说着就要拆包裹，非要请我吃月饼不可。我说家里什么馅儿的月饼都有，还是赶快给女儿打电话吧。
lines.py: Wǒ xīnli yǐnyuē yǒuxiē bù'ān, bàozhe bāoguǒ jiù wǎng gōngdì pǎo, zhǎo le yí wèi gōngrén, qǐng tā bāngmáng zhǎo Zhāng shīfu. Yíhuìr, húnshēn hànshuǐ de Zhāng shīfu lái le. Tā jiàn le wǒ yòu shì dàoqiàn yòu shì gǎnxiè, shuō jīntiān tèbié máng, shǒujī méi diàn le dōu bù zhīdào. Shuōzhe jiù yào chāi bāoguǒ, fēi yào qǐng wǒ chī yuèbing bùkě. Wǒ shuō jiāli shénme xiànr de yuèbing dōu yǒu, háishi gǎnkuài gěi nǚ'ér dǎ diànhuà ba.
lines.en: I felt vaguely uneasy, so I grabbed the package and ran to the construction site, where I found a worker and asked him to help me find Master Zhang. After a while, Master Zhang came over, drenched in sweat. When he saw me, he apologized and thanked me over and over, saying he had been especially busy today and hadn't even noticed his phone had died. As he spoke he started to open the package, insisting that I have some mooncakes. I said we had mooncakes with every kind of filling at home, and he'd better call his daughter right away.

lines.zh: 电话通了，张师傅满脸慈爱，笑得别提多灿烂了：“心心，月饼爸爸收到了，……我身体好着呢，别惦记，好好工作，别给爸爸丢人啊……”讲完电话，张师傅还没忘了向我炫耀他的女儿，“要面子着呢，从来没有辜负过我的期望。”
lines.py: Diànhuà tōng le, Zhāng shīfu mǎn liǎn cí'ài, xiào de biétí duō cànlàn le: "Xīnxin, yuèbing bàba shōudào le, …… wǒ shēntǐ hǎozhe ne, bié diànji, hǎohāor gōngzuò, bié gěi bàba diūrén a……" Jiǎngwán diànhuà, Zhāng shīfu hái méi wàng le xiàng wǒ xuànyào tā de nǚ'ér, "Yào miànzi zhe ne, cónglái méiyǒu gūfù guo wǒ de qīwàng."
lines.en: The call went through, and Master Zhang's face was full of tenderness, his smile as bright as could be: "Xinxin, Dad got the mooncakes... I'm in great health, don't worry about me. Work hard, and don't embarrass your dad..." After hanging up, Master Zhang didn't forget to show off his daughter to me: "She really cares about her reputation—she's never once let me down."

lines.zh: 看得出，女儿是他的幸福。
lines.py: Kàn de chū, nǚ'ér shì tā de xìngfú.
lines.en: You could tell his daughter was his happiness.

他搓着手，迟疑地说：“有件事想拜托你。”

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
老鼠是山神的宠物，它厌倦了宠物的生活，也很厌恶宠物这个角色，于是向山神请假，要求到动物世界走一回，心想一定要找机会证明一下自己的实力。山神说：“动物世界中，大象是最强大的，倘若你还想回来，必须战胜大象，否则，你就永远留在动物世界吧。”老鼠答应了山神的条件，并暗自把挑战目标定为了大象。
老鼠一来到动物界，便发觉它对山神的承诺是多么草率，它是那么弱小，丝毫没有对抗大象的力量，但老鼠还是决定尝试一下。它想，我太小了，不可以盲目行动，但我可以乘大象不注意，进到大象鼻子里去，大象不能喘气了，就得请求我饶恕，我就可以强迫它认输。
这天，大象正在吃树叶，老鼠乘机跑进大象的鼻子中，准备实施它的计划。不料，刚进去，大象痒得难受，猛烈地打起了喷嚏，老鼠像子弹一样被射了出来。大象用蔑视的眼光盯着它，愤怒地说：“你这个愚蠢的家伙，太可恶了，下次再要滋事，我一定踩扁了你。”从此老鼠再也不敢挑战大象了。
那是一个夕阳将落的傍晚，大象不留神落入了打猎者设下的巨网中。它不顾一切地用力挣扎，往外乱窜，想摆脱巨网，可是，它的一切努力都没用。大象又悲伤又害怕，它觉得死亡越来越近了。恰巧，老鼠看到了这一切，它想，大象现在毫无抵抗能力，只要我在它身体的重要部位咬几个洞，它就没命了，我不就战胜大象了吗？然而，看到大象悲惨的样子，老鼠不忍下手，它觉得那样未免太过残忍，良心告诉它，应该救大象，于是，它开始用锋利的牙齿咬缠绕着大象的网和绳子。不知过了多久，老鼠几乎耗费了全部力气，绳子终于被咬断了，巨网出现了一个大缺口，大象猛地一用力，脱离了巨网。
从此，老鼠和大象成了好朋友。
不久，山神找到了老鼠，要它回到自己身边。老鼠说：“这大概不可能了，我无法战胜大象。”山神说：“你化敌为友，创造了举世瞩目的成就，世界上还有比这更完美的胜利吗？”

lines.zh: 老鼠是山神的宠物，它厌倦了宠物的生活，也很厌恶宠物这个角色，于是向山神请假，要求到动物世界走一回，心想一定要找机会证明一下自己的实力。山神说：“动物世界中，大象是最强大的，倘若你还想回来，必须战胜大象，否则，你就永远留在动物世界吧。”老鼠答应了山神的条件，并暗自把挑战目标定为了大象。
lines.py: Lǎoshǔ shì shānshén de chǒngwù, tā yànjuàn le chǒngwù de shēnghuó, yě hěn yànwù chǒngwù zhège juésè, yúshì xiàng shānshén qǐngjià, yāoqiú dào dòngwù shìjiè zǒu yì huí, xīn xiǎng yídìng yào zhǎo jīhuì zhèngmíng yíxià zìjǐ de shílì. Shānshén shuō: "Dòngwù shìjiè zhōng, dàxiàng shì zuì qiángdà de, tǎngruò nǐ hái xiǎng huílai, bìxū zhànshèng dàxiàng, fǒuzé, nǐ jiù yǒngyuǎn liú zài dòngwù shìjiè ba." Lǎoshǔ dāying le shānshén de tiáojiàn, bìng ànzì bǎ tiǎozhàn mùbiāo dìngwéi le dàxiàng.
lines.en: The mouse was the mountain god's pet. It had grown tired of a pet's life and loathed the role of pet, so it asked the mountain god for leave, requesting to go into the animal world for a while, determined to find a chance to prove its strength. The mountain god said, "In the animal world, the elephant is the mightiest. If you want to come back, you must defeat the elephant; otherwise, you'll stay in the animal world forever." The mouse accepted the mountain god's condition and secretly set the elephant as the target of its challenge.

lines.zh: 老鼠一来到动物界，便发觉它对山神的承诺是多么草率，它是那么弱小，丝毫没有对抗大象的力量，但老鼠还是决定尝试一下。它想，我太小了，不可以盲目行动，但我可以乘大象不注意，进到大象鼻子里去，大象不能喘气了，就得请求我饶恕，我就可以强迫它认输。
lines.py: Lǎoshǔ yì láidào dòngwùjiè, biàn fājué tā duì shānshén de chéngnuò shì duōme cǎoshuài, tā shì nàme ruòxiǎo, sīháo méiyǒu duìkàng dàxiàng de lìliang, dàn lǎoshǔ háishi juédìng chángshì yíxià. Tā xiǎng, wǒ tài xiǎo le, bù kěyǐ mángmù xíngdòng, dàn wǒ kěyǐ chéng dàxiàng bú zhùyì, jìndào dàxiàng bízi li qù, dàxiàng bù néng chuǎnqì le, jiù děi qǐngqiú wǒ ráoshù, wǒ jiù kěyǐ qiǎngpò tā rènshū.
lines.en: As soon as the mouse arrived in the animal kingdom, it realized how rash its promise to the mountain god had been. It was so small and weak, without the slightest power to take on an elephant, but it still decided to give it a try. It thought: I'm too small to act blindly, but I can sneak into the elephant's trunk while it isn't paying attention. Once the elephant can't breathe, it will have to beg me for mercy, and then I can force it to admit defeat.

lines.zh: 这天，大象正在吃树叶，老鼠乘机跑进大象的鼻子中，准备实施它的计划。不料，刚进去，大象痒得难受，猛烈地打起了喷嚏，老鼠像子弹一样被射了出来。大象用蔑视的眼光盯着它，愤怒地说：“你这个愚蠢的家伙，太可恶了，下次再要滋事，我一定踩扁了你。”从此老鼠再也不敢挑战大象了。
lines.py: Zhè tiān, dàxiàng zhèngzài chī shùyè, lǎoshǔ chéngjī pǎojìn dàxiàng de bízi zhōng, zhǔnbèi shíshī tā de jìhuà. Búliào, gāng jìnqu, dàxiàng yǎng de nánshòu, měngliè de dǎqǐ le pēntì, lǎoshǔ xiàng zǐdàn yíyàng bèi shè le chūlai. Dàxiàng yòng mièshì de yǎnguāng dīngzhe tā, fènnù de shuō: "Nǐ zhège yúchǔn de jiāhuo, tài kěwù le, xià cì zài yào zīshì, wǒ yídìng cǎibiǎn le nǐ." Cóngcǐ lǎoshǔ zài yě bù gǎn tiǎozhàn dàxiàng le.
lines.en: One day, while the elephant was eating leaves, the mouse seized the chance to slip into its trunk, ready to carry out its plan. Unexpectedly, no sooner had it gotten in than the elephant, unbearably itchy, sneezed violently, and the mouse shot out like a bullet. The elephant glared at it contemptuously and said angrily, "You stupid creature, how hateful you are! If you make trouble again, I'll squash you flat." From then on, the mouse never dared to challenge the elephant again.

lines.zh: 那是一个夕阳将落的傍晚，大象不留神落入了打猎者设下的巨网中。它不顾一切地用力挣扎，往外乱窜，想摆脱巨网，可是，它的一切努力都没用。大象又悲伤又害怕，它觉得死亡越来越近了。恰巧，老鼠看到了这一切，它想，大象现在毫无抵抗能力，只要我在它身体的重要部位咬几个洞，它就没命了，我不就战胜大象了吗？然而，看到大象悲惨的样子，老鼠不忍下手，它觉得那样未免太过残忍，良心告诉它，应该救大象，于是，它开始用锋利的牙齿咬缠绕着大象的网和绳子。不知过了多久，老鼠几乎耗费了全部力气，绳子终于被咬断了，巨网出现了一个大缺口，大象猛地一用力，脱离了巨网。
lines.py: Nà shì yí ge xīyáng jiāng luò de bàngwǎn, dàxiàng bù liúshén luòrù le dǎlièzhě shèxia de jù wǎng zhōng. Tā búgù yíqiè de yònglì zhēngzhá, wǎng wài luàn cuàn, xiǎng bǎituō jù wǎng, kěshì, tā de yíqiè nǔlì dōu méi yòng. Dàxiàng yòu bēishāng yòu hàipà, tā juéde sǐwáng yuè lái yuè jìn le. Qiàqiǎo, lǎoshǔ kàndào le zhè yíqiè, tā xiǎng, dàxiàng xiànzài háo wú dǐkàng nénglì, zhǐyào wǒ zài tā shēntǐ de zhòngyào bùwèi yǎo jǐ ge dòng, tā jiù méi mìng le, wǒ bú jiù zhànshèng dàxiàng le ma? Rán'ér, kàndào dàxiàng bēicǎn de yàngzi, lǎoshǔ bùrěn xiàshǒu, tā juéde nàyàng wèimiǎn tài guò cánrěn, liángxīn gàosu tā, yīnggāi jiù dàxiàng, yúshì, tā kāishǐ yòng fēnglì de yáchǐ yǎo chánràozhe dàxiàng de wǎng hé shéngzi. Bù zhī guò le duō jiǔ, lǎoshǔ jīhū hàofèi le quánbù lìqi, shéngzi zhōngyú bèi yǎoduàn le, jù wǎng chūxiàn le yí ge dà quēkǒu, dàxiàng měng de yí yònglì, tuōlí le jù wǎng.
lines.en: It was an evening when the sun was about to set. The elephant carelessly fell into a huge net set by hunters. It struggled desperately with all its might, thrashing about wildly to break free of the net, but all its efforts were in vain. The elephant was both sad and frightened; it felt death drawing closer and closer. As it happened, the mouse saw all of this. It thought: the elephant is now completely defenseless—if I bite a few holes in vital parts of its body, it will die, and then haven't I defeated the elephant? But seeing the elephant's pitiful state, the mouse couldn't bring itself to do it; that would be far too cruel. Its conscience told it that it should save the elephant, so it began gnawing with its sharp teeth at the net and ropes wrapped around the elephant. Who knows how long it took, but the mouse used up almost all its strength until the ropes were finally bitten through. A big gap opened in the net, and with one mighty heave the elephant broke free.

lines.zh: 从此，老鼠和大象成了好朋友。
lines.py: Cóngcǐ, lǎoshǔ hé dàxiàng chéng le hǎo péngyou.
lines.en: From then on, the mouse and the elephant became good friends.

lines.zh: 不久，山神找到了老鼠，要它回到自己身边。老鼠说：“这大概不可能了，我无法战胜大象。”山神说：“你化敌为友，创造了举世瞩目的成就，世界上还有比这更完美的胜利吗？”
lines.py: Bùjiǔ, shānshén zhǎodào le lǎoshǔ, yào tā huídào zìjǐ shēnbiān. Lǎoshǔ shuō: "Zhè dàgài bù kěnéng le, wǒ wúfǎ zhànshèng dàxiàng." Shānshén shuō: "Nǐ huà dí wéi yǒu, chuàngzào le jǔshì zhǔmù de chéngjiù, shìjiè shang hái yǒu bǐ zhè gèng wánměi de shènglì ma?"
lines.en: Before long, the mountain god found the mouse and asked it to come back. The mouse said, "I'm afraid that's impossible—I can't defeat the elephant." The mountain god said, "You turned an enemy into a friend and achieved something the whole world admires. Is there any victory in the world more perfect than that?"

sentences.text: 从此老鼠再也不敢挑战大象了。
大象又悲伤又害怕，它觉得死亡越来越近了。
从此，老鼠和大象成了好朋友。
不久，山神找到了老鼠，要它回到自己身边。

lessons.name: 学一门外语需要理由吗

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
我想学一门外语，迫不及待地想不再依靠翻译，独自阅读原文，哪怕是借助字典勉强查阅呢。我很快找到了一家语言学习机构，它在离我家不远的一栋办公楼上。这天我兴致勃勃地专程前去咨询。
进了门，一位很有修养的女士迎上来，我以为交了学费就能开始快乐而美好的学习了，不料首先面对的是她接连不断的发问：“为什么要学外语？最近有出国计划吗？职业是什么？”
“这很重要吗？”说实在的，她的问题涉及了我的隐私，我很反感，话也变得火药味十足。
她极力忍耐着，“是这样，我必须了解学员，为学员着想，帮他策划学习方案，以达成他的目标。”
我努力使自己的口气缓和下来：“我没什么具体目标。就是找一个班插班听课，随意学学而已。”
“可是，我们的班都是根据学员的具体情况设置的，如果您没有具体目标，是学不好一种语言的。”
没有目标就缺乏动力，这道理我固然懂，可是，我的确说不出她所说的目标。我说我回去想想。
“您等一下。”她迅速出门，瞬间换来了一位男士。“您学这门语言是为了……”他态度和蔼，真诚恳切，我被打动了，跟他滔滔不绝起来：“我喜欢这个国家的文化，学习语言无非是为了看原文电影、读文学作品……”
“明白了。不想通过翻译，直接进入原文的世界？”
“对！”我欢天喜地，终于碰上了知音。
“我碰到过您这样的客户，可是，光凭兴趣，恐怕难以持久。”我顿时崩溃了，怎么说着说着又绕回来了。
我果断地站起来，斩钉截铁地表明要走。
回家后，我不死心，开始在网上找在线学习。后来发现有一家，还真不错，从基础教起，每个句子的语法都详细讲解，不留死角，和我的思维很搭。更重要的是心里舒服——没有人硬逼着我执行学习计划，也没人问我为啥要学它，以及我的单位、身份，包括薪水——我就是个语言学习者，你管我这些干吗？
我的学习方式绝对对学习效果有利，当然弊端也不少：有利的方面如上所说，弊端在于高兴了拼命学一阵子，不高兴了就搁在一边。有时还前后颠倒，因为后面那课的话题太诱惑我了。但是，利弊权衡，利还是大于弊。因为我总能在忘我的快乐中，津津有味地享受学习。

lines.zh: 我想学一门外语，迫不及待地想不再依靠翻译，独自阅读原文，哪怕是借助字典勉强查阅呢。我很快找到了一家语言学习机构，它在离我家不远的一栋办公楼上。这天我兴致勃勃地专程前去咨询。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng xué yì mén wàiyǔ, pòbù jídài de xiǎng bú zài yīkào fānyì, dúzì yuèdú yuánwén, nǎpà shì jièzhù zìdiǎn miǎnqiǎng cháyuè ne. Wǒ hěn kuài zhǎodào le yì jiā yǔyán xuéxí jīgòu, tā zài lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn de yí dòng bàngōnglóu shang. Zhè tiān wǒ xìngzhì bóbó de zhuānchéng qiánqù zīxún.
lines.en: I wanted to learn a foreign language. I couldn't wait to stop depending on translations and read original texts on my own, even if I had to struggle through with the help of a dictionary. I quickly found a language school in an office building not far from my home. One day I made a special trip there, full of enthusiasm, to inquire.

lines.zh: 进了门，一位很有修养的女士迎上来，我以为交了学费就能开始快乐而美好的学习了，不料首先面对的是她接连不断的发问：“为什么要学外语？最近有出国计划吗？职业是什么？”
lines.py: Jìn le mén, yí wèi hěn yǒu xiūyǎng de nǚshì yíng shanglai, wǒ yǐwéi jiāo le xuéfèi jiù néng kāishǐ kuàilè ér měihǎo de xuéxí le, búliào shǒuxiān miànduì de shì tā jiēlián búduàn de fāwèn: "Wèishénme yào xué wàiyǔ? Zuìjìn yǒu chūguó jìhuà ma? Zhíyè shì shénme?"
lines.en: When I went in, a very cultivated lady came up to greet me. I thought that once I paid the tuition I could start a happy and wonderful course of study, but unexpectedly, the first thing I faced was a barrage of questions from her: "Why do you want to learn a foreign language? Do you have any plans to go abroad soon? What's your occupation?"

lines.zh: “这很重要吗？”说实在的，她的问题涉及了我的隐私，我很反感，话也变得火药味十足。
lines.py: "Zhè hěn zhòngyào ma?" Shuō shízài de, tā de wèntí shèjí le wǒ de yǐnsī, wǒ hěn fǎngǎn, huà yě biàn de huǒyàowèir shízú.
lines.en: "Is that important?" To be honest, her questions touched on my privacy, and I was quite put off; my words became full of hostility.

lines.zh: 她极力忍耐着，“是这样，我必须了解学员，为学员着想，帮他策划学习方案，以达成他的目标。”
lines.py: Tā jílì rěnnàizhe, "Shì zhèyàng, wǒ bìxū liǎojiě xuéyuán, wèi xuéyuán zhuóxiǎng, bāng tā cèhuà xuéxí fāng'àn, yǐ dáchéng tā de mùbiāo."
lines.en: She tried hard to stay patient: "The thing is, I need to understand our students and think from their point of view, so I can help them plan a course of study that meets their goals."

lines.zh: 我努力使自己的口气缓和下来：“我没什么具体目标。就是找一个班插班听课，随意学学而已。”
lines.py: Wǒ nǔlì shǐ zìjǐ de kǒuqì huǎnhé xialai: "Wǒ méi shénme jùtǐ mùbiāo. Jiù shì zhǎo yí ge bān chābān tīngkè, suíyì xuéxue éryǐ."
lines.en: I tried to soften my tone: "I don't have any specific goal. I just want to join a class partway through and sit in, learning casually, that's all."

lines.zh: “可是，我们的班都是根据学员的具体情况设置的，如果您没有具体目标，是学不好一种语言的。”
lines.py: "Kěshì, wǒmen de bān dōu shì gēnjù xuéyuán de jùtǐ qíngkuàng shèzhì de, rúguǒ nín méiyǒu jùtǐ mùbiāo, shì xué bu hǎo yì zhǒng yǔyán de."
lines.en: "But our classes are all set up according to each student's specific situation. If you don't have a specific goal, you won't learn a language well."

lines.zh: 没有目标就缺乏动力，这道理我固然懂，可是，我的确说不出她所说的目标。我说我回去想想。
lines.py: Méiyǒu mùbiāo jiù quēfá dònglì, zhè dàoli wǒ gùrán dǒng, kěshì, wǒ díquè shuō bu chū tā suǒ shuō de mùbiāo. Wǒ shuō wǒ huíqu xiǎngxiang.
lines.en: Without a goal you lack motivation—of course I understood that, but I really couldn't name the kind of goal she was talking about. I said I'd go home and think about it.

lines.zh: “您等一下。”她迅速出门，瞬间换来了一位男士。“您学这门语言是为了……”他态度和蔼，真诚恳切，我被打动了，跟他滔滔不绝起来：“我喜欢这个国家的文化，学习语言无非是为了看原文电影、读文学作品……”
lines.py: "Nín děng yíxià." Tā xùnsù chūmén, shùnjiān huànlai le yí wèi nánshì. "Nín xué zhè mén yǔyán shì wèile……" Tā tàidu hé'ǎi, zhēnchéng kěnqiè, wǒ bèi dǎdòng le, gēn tā tāotāo bù jué qilai: "Wǒ xǐhuan zhège guójiā de wénhuà, xuéxí yǔyán wúfēi shì wèile kàn yuánwén diànyǐng, dú wénxué zuòpǐn……"
lines.en: "One moment, please." She hurried out and in an instant came back with a man in her place. "You're learning this language in order to..." He was kind, sincere and earnest; I was moved and started talking to him nonstop: "I love this country's culture. I'm learning the language simply to watch films in the original and read its literature..."

lines.zh: “明白了。不想通过翻译，直接进入原文的世界？”
lines.py: "Míngbai le. Bù xiǎng tōngguò fānyì, zhíjiē jìnrù yuánwén de shìjiè?"
lines.en: "I see. You don't want to go through translation—you want to enter the world of the original directly?"

lines.zh: “对！”我欢天喜地，终于碰上了知音。
lines.py: "Duì!" Wǒ huāntiān xǐdì, zhōngyú pèngshang le zhīyīn.
lines.en: "Yes!" I was overjoyed—I had finally met someone who understood me.

lines.zh: “我碰到过您这样的客户，可是，光凭兴趣，恐怕难以持久。”我顿时崩溃了，怎么说着说着又绕回来了。
lines.py: "Wǒ pèngdào guo nín zhèyàng de kèhù, kěshì, guāng píng xìngqù, kǒngpà nányǐ chíjiǔ." Wǒ dùnshí bēngkuì le, zěnme shuōzhe shuōzhe yòu rào huilai le.
lines.en: "I've met clients like you before, but interest alone is probably hard to sustain." I instantly fell apart—how had we talked our way back around to the same point again?

lines.zh: 我果断地站起来，斩钉截铁地表明要走。
lines.py: Wǒ guǒduàn de zhàn qilai, zhǎndīng jiétiě de biǎomíng yào zǒu.
lines.en: I stood up decisively and stated flatly that I was leaving.

lines.zh: 回家后，我不死心，开始在网上找在线学习。后来发现有一家，还真不错，从基础教起，每个句子的语法都详细讲解，不留死角，和我的思维很搭。更重要的是心里舒服——没有人硬逼着我执行学习计划，也没人问我为啥要学它，以及我的单位、身份，包括薪水——我就是个语言学习者，你管我这些干吗？
lines.py: Huí jiā hòu, wǒ bù sǐxīn, kāishǐ zài wǎngshang zhǎo zàixiàn xuéxí. Hòulái fāxiàn yǒu yì jiā, hái zhēn búcuò, cóng jīchǔ jiāoqǐ, měi ge jùzi de yǔfǎ dōu xiángxì jiǎngjiě, bù liú sǐjiǎo, hé wǒ de sīwéi hěn dā. Gèng zhòngyào de shì xīnli shūfu — méiyǒu rén yìng bīzhe wǒ zhíxíng xuéxí jìhuà, yě méi rén wèn wǒ wèi shá yào xué tā, yǐjí wǒ de dānwèi, shēnfen, bāokuò xīnshui — wǒ jiù shì ge yǔyán xuéxízhě, nǐ guǎn wǒ zhèxiē gànmá?
lines.en: Back home, I didn't give up and started looking for online courses. Eventually I found one that was really quite good: it taught from the basics, explained the grammar of every sentence in detail without leaving any gaps, and suited the way I think. More importantly, I felt comfortable—no one forced me to follow a study plan, and no one asked why I wanted to learn it, or about my workplace, my status, or even my salary. I'm just a language learner—why should you care about any of that?

lines.zh: 我的学习方式绝对对学习效果有利，当然弊端也不少：有利的方面如上所说，弊端在于高兴了拼命学一阵子，不高兴了就搁在一边。有时还前后颠倒，因为后面那课的话题太诱惑我了。但是，利弊权衡，利还是大于弊。因为我总能在忘我的快乐中，津津有味地享受学习。
lines.py: Wǒ de xuéxí fāngshì juéduì duì xuéxí xiàoguǒ yǒulì, dāngrán bìduān yě bù shǎo: yǒulì de fāngmiàn rú shàng suǒ shuō, bìduān zàiyú gāoxìng le pīnmìng xué yízhènzi, bù gāoxìng le jiù gē zài yìbiān. Yǒushí hái qiánhòu diāndǎo, yīnwèi hòumian nà kè de huàtí tài yòuhuò wǒ le. Dànshì, lìbì quánhéng, lì háishi dàyú bì. Yīnwèi wǒ zǒng néng zài wàngwǒ de kuàilè zhōng, jīnjīn yǒu wèi de xiǎngshòu xuéxí.
lines.en: My way of learning is definitely good for results, though of course it has plenty of drawbacks too. The advantages are as described above; the drawback is that when I'm in a good mood I study like mad for a while, and when I'm not, I put it aside. Sometimes I even go out of order, because the topic of a later lesson is too tempting. But weighing the pros and cons, the pros still outweigh the cons, because I can always enjoy learning with great relish, absorbed in a joy that makes me forget myself.

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
这天是我到这家公司上任的第一天，我的职位是咨询师。早就听说这里老手多、新手少，不少资深员工在公司创立之初就开始在这里工作了。
清早上班，和新同事一一认识后，我以为一天的工作就此开始，没想到赵姐工作的第一件事是忙着沏茶和咖啡，给张哥端一碗，给孙姐送一杯……我想这单位风气真好，明天这事我来做。正想着，赵姐已经坐在那儿开始自己享受，唯独剩下我和我的搭档——与我同一天就职的小林。顿时小林的脸色变了，我也有被边缘化的感觉，不过我还是向小林使了个眼色。屋子里鸦雀无声，第一天就这样开始了。
我和小林的业务很难做，件件都让人头痛，有时候还完不成指标，可别人的工作很快就完了，几乎成天聊天儿、上网、吹牛，还有人溜出去逛街。我和小林虽然是新来的，可我们之前在别的公司也是好手呀。
后来我发现，领导分配业务时，总是让资深员工先挑，他们挑剩下的才是我和小林的。我们的工作从难度上讲，和他们根本就不是一个等级。小林要去找领导讨公道：“哼，太不像话了，明明是在欺负人，大不了辞职。”我也觉得不像话，可静下来，也觉得没什么不好，应该说这反而是我们可以展示自己才干的好机会。
我和小林决定不和他们计较，全力以赴投入工作，不怠慢、不敷衍每一位客户，想方设法做好每一单业务，多忙都不凑合。
忙碌中，时光过得飞快，我们的业务能力得到了飞跃式的提高，点名找我们的客户越来越多。有时领导会说，服务对象对张哥不满意，活儿你们接手吧；客户投诉赵姐了，你们处理一下吧。我们每天都充满激情地工作，享受着工作的快乐。年度考核，我和小林的敬业精神、兢兢业业的工作态度受到了表扬，经济上也得到了丰厚的回报。当初对我们不友好的资深前辈们也变得热情起来。再后来，公司来了新人，领导让我带他们，我把工作经验和技巧传授给他们，毫无保留。
其实，进入新单位，作为一个职场插班生，这个过程，正是展示你人格魅力的时候，遇到困难，也是你施展才能的时机。

lines.zh: 这天是我到这家公司上任的第一天，我的职位是咨询师。早就听说这里老手多、新手少，不少资深员工在公司创立之初就开始在这里工作了。
lines.py: Zhè tiān shì wǒ dào zhè jiā gōngsī shàngrèn de dì-yī tiān, wǒ de zhíwèi shì zīxúnshī. Zǎo jiù tīngshuō zhèli lǎoshǒu duō, xīnshǒu shǎo, bù shǎo zīshēn yuángōng zài gōngsī chuànglì zhī chū jiù kāishǐ zài zhèli gōngzuò le.
lines.en: That day was my first day on the job at this company; my position was consultant. I had long heard that there were many old hands and few newcomers here, and that quite a few senior employees had been working here since the company was founded.

lines.zh: 清早上班，和新同事一一认识后，我以为一天的工作就此开始，没想到赵姐工作的第一件事是忙着沏茶和咖啡，给张哥端一碗，给孙姐送一杯……我想这单位风气真好，明天这事我来做。正想着，赵姐已经坐在那儿开始自己享受，唯独剩下我和我的搭档——与我同一天就职的小林。顿时小林的脸色变了，我也有被边缘化的感觉，不过我还是向小林使了个眼色。屋子里鸦雀无声，第一天就这样开始了。
lines.py: Qīngzǎo shàngbān, hé xīn tóngshì yīyī rènshi hòu, wǒ yǐwéi yì tiān de gōngzuò jiù cǐ kāishǐ, méi xiǎngdào Zhào jiě gōngzuò de dì-yī jiàn shì shì mángzhe qī chá hé kāfēi, gěi Zhāng gē duān yì wǎn, gěi Sūn jiě sòng yì bēi…… Wǒ xiǎng zhè dānwèi fēngqì zhēn hǎo, míngtiān zhè shì wǒ lái zuò. Zhèng xiǎngzhe, Zhào jiě yǐjīng zuò zài nàr kāishǐ zìjǐ xiǎngshòu, wéidú shèngxia wǒ hé wǒ de dādàng — yǔ wǒ tóng yì tiān jiùzhí de Xiǎo Lín. Dùnshí Xiǎo Lín de liǎnsè biàn le, wǒ yě yǒu bèi biānyuánhuà de gǎnjué, búguò wǒ háishi xiàng Xiǎo Lín shǐ le ge yǎnsè. Wūzi li yāquè wú shēng, dì-yī tiān jiù zhèyàng kāishǐ le.
lines.en: Arriving at work early in the morning, after meeting my new colleagues one by one, I thought the day's work would begin. To my surprise, the first thing Sister Zhao did was busily make tea and coffee—a bowl for Brother Zhang, a cup for Sister Sun... I thought what a great atmosphere this workplace had, and decided I'd do it tomorrow. Just as I was thinking this, Sister Zhao was already sitting there enjoying her own, leaving out only me and my partner, Xiao Lin, who had started on the same day as me. Xiao Lin's face fell at once, and I too felt pushed to the margins, but I still gave Xiao Lin a meaningful look. The room was dead silent, and that's how the first day began.

lines.zh: 我和小林的业务很难做，件件都让人头痛，有时候还完不成指标，可别人的工作很快就完了，几乎成天聊天儿、上网、吹牛，还有人溜出去逛街。我和小林虽然是新来的，可我们之前在别的公司也是好手呀。
lines.py: Wǒ hé Xiǎo Lín de yèwù hěn nán zuò, jiànjiàn dōu ràng rén tóutòng, yǒu shíhou hái wán bu chéng zhǐbiāo, kě biérén de gōngzuò hěn kuài jiù wán le, jīhū chéngtiān liáotiānr, shàngwǎng, chuīniú, hái yǒu rén liū chuqu guàngjiē. Wǒ hé Xiǎo Lín suīrán shì xīn lái de, kě wǒmen zhīqián zài bié de gōngsī yě shì hǎoshǒu ya.
lines.en: The assignments Xiao Lin and I got were very hard—every one of them was a headache, and sometimes we couldn't even meet our targets. But the others finished their work quickly and spent almost all day chatting, surfing the internet and bragging, and some even slipped out to go shopping. Although Xiao Lin and I were new, we had been top performers at our previous companies too.

lines.zh: 后来我发现，领导分配业务时，总是让资深员工先挑，他们挑剩下的才是我和小林的。我们的工作从难度上讲，和他们根本就不是一个等级。小林要去找领导讨公道：“哼，太不像话了，明明是在欺负人，大不了辞职。”我也觉得不像话，可静下来，也觉得没什么不好，应该说这反而是我们可以展示自己才干的好机会。
lines.py: Hòulái wǒ fāxiàn, lǐngdǎo fēnpèi yèwù shí, zǒngshì ràng zīshēn yuángōng xiān tiāo, tāmen tiāo shèngxia de cái shì wǒ hé Xiǎo Lín de. Wǒmen de gōngzuò cóng nándù shang jiǎng, hé tāmen gēnběn jiù bú shì yí ge děngjí. Xiǎo Lín yào qù zhǎo lǐngdǎo tǎo gōngdao: "Hēng, tài bú xiànghuà le, míngmíng shì zài qīfu rén, dàbuliǎo cízhí." Wǒ yě juéde bú xiànghuà, kě jìng xialai, yě juéde méi shénme bù hǎo, yīnggāi shuō zhè fǎn'ér shì wǒmen kěyǐ zhǎnshì zìjǐ cáigàn de hǎo jīhuì.
lines.en: Later I discovered that when the boss assigned work, the senior staff always got to choose first, and only what they left over went to Xiao Lin and me. In terms of difficulty, our work simply wasn't in the same league as theirs. Xiao Lin wanted to go to the boss and demand fair treatment: "Hmph, this is outrageous! They're clearly bullying us. If worst comes to worst, I'll quit." I also thought it was outrageous, but when I calmed down I felt there was nothing so bad about it—if anything, it was a good opportunity for us to show what we could do.

lines.zh: 我和小林决定不和他们计较，全力以赴投入工作，不怠慢、不敷衍每一位客户，想方设法做好每一单业务，多忙都不凑合。
lines.py: Wǒ hé Xiǎo Lín juédìng bù hé tāmen jìjiào, quánlì yǐ fù tóurù gōngzuò, bú dàimàn, bù fūyan měi yí wèi kèhù, xiǎngfāng shèfǎ zuòhǎo měi yì dān yèwù, duō máng dōu bú còuhe.
lines.en: Xiao Lin and I decided not to haggle with them and threw ourselves into our work with everything we had. We never neglected or brushed off a single client, did everything we could to handle every order well, and never cut corners no matter how busy we were.

lines.zh: 忙碌中，时光过得飞快，我们的业务能力得到了飞跃式的提高，点名找我们的客户越来越多。有时领导会说，服务对象对张哥不满意，活儿你们接手吧；客户投诉赵姐了，你们处理一下吧。我们每天都充满激情地工作，享受着工作的快乐。年度考核，我和小林的敬业精神、兢兢业业的工作态度受到了表扬，经济上也得到了丰厚的回报。当初对我们不友好的资深前辈们也变得热情起来。再后来，公司来了新人，领导让我带他们，我把工作经验和技巧传授给他们，毫无保留。
lines.py: Mánglù zhōng, shíguāng guò de fēikuài, wǒmen de yèwù nénglì dédào le fēiyuèshì de tígāo, diǎnmíng zhǎo wǒmen de kèhù yuè lái yuè duō. Yǒushí lǐngdǎo huì shuō, fúwù duìxiàng duì Zhāng gē bù mǎnyì, huór nǐmen jiēshǒu ba; kèhù tóusù Zhào jiě le, nǐmen chǔlǐ yíxià ba. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu chōngmǎn jīqíng de gōngzuò, xiǎngshòuzhe gōngzuò de kuàilè. Niándù kǎohé, wǒ hé Xiǎo Lín de jìngyè jīngshén, jīngjīng yèyè de gōngzuò tàidu shòudào le biǎoyáng, jīngjì shang yě dédào le fēnghòu de huíbào. Dāngchū duì wǒmen bù yǒuhǎo de zīshēn qiánbèimen yě biàn de rèqíng qilai. Zài hòulái, gōngsī lái le xīnrén, lǐngdǎo ràng wǒ dài tāmen, wǒ bǎ gōngzuò jīngyàn hé jìqiǎo chuánshòu gěi tāmen, háo wú bǎoliú.
lines.en: Time flew by in our busyness, and our professional skills improved by leaps and bounds; more and more clients asked for us by name. Sometimes the boss would say, a client isn't happy with Brother Zhang, you two take over the job; or, a customer has complained about Sister Zhao, you two deal with it. We worked with passion every day, enjoying the pleasure of our work. In the annual review, Xiao Lin and I were praised for our dedication and conscientious attitude, and we were also handsomely rewarded financially. The senior colleagues who had been unfriendly to us at first became warm, too. Later still, when new people joined the company, the boss had me mentor them, and I passed on my work experience and skills to them without holding anything back.

lines.zh: 其实，进入新单位，作为一个职场插班生，这个过程，正是展示你人格魅力的时候，遇到困难，也是你施展才能的时机。
lines.py: Qíshí, jìnrù xīn dānwèi, zuòwéi yí ge zhíchǎng chābānshēng, zhège guòchéng, zhèng shì zhǎnshì nǐ réngé mèilì de shíhou, yùdào kùnnan, yě shì nǐ shīzhǎn cáinéng de shíjī.
lines.en: In fact, when you join a new workplace as a mid-term newcomer, that process is exactly the time to show your personal charm, and running into difficulties is also your opportunity to display your talents.

我们的工作从难度上讲，和他们根本就不是一个等级。
客户投诉赵姐了，你们处理一下吧。
我们每天都充满激情地工作，享受着工作的快乐。
当初对我们不友好的资深前辈们也变得热情起来。

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
最近，小王正为工作的事伤脑筋。毕业于3年前的他，一直做会计，成天和数字打交道，枯燥而且压力大，他做梦都想换一份工作。小王对艺术、心理学都感兴趣，觉得当老师也不错，可他不确定自己真正擅长什么，怕万一选错了，要付出很大的时间成本和经济成本，为此他变得急躁、紧张、顾虑重重。
心理专家认为，对自己缺乏信心，对未来过度悲观致使小王出现以上现象。悲观主要包括：我不敢想最坏的结果是什么；我无法承受这个结果；一旦选错，终身悔恨，甚至会觉得人生都没有希望了。其实，类似小王这样的年轻人并非少数。不知道小王们是否读过下面这段对话：
年轻人：你的智慧从哪里来？
乔布斯：来自精确的判断力。
年轻人：精确的判断力从哪里来？
乔布斯：来自经验的积累。
年轻人：那你的经验又从哪里来？
乔布斯：来自无数错误的判断。
做决定是一种能力，而能力不是天生的，是通过实践和挫折得来的，在这个过程中，人同时具有了坚定的意志力和敏锐的判断力，不畏惧付出和失败，勇于承担责任，这就是成长。
事实上，伴随着经济全球化，生活中的不确定因素日益增多。昔日风光无限的世界一流企业也会亏损，也会倒闭；一次金融危机，就会使一些连年盈利、运行很好的企业不得不裁员。这意味着，原本英明的决定今天看来可能并非如此了。
依我看，无论你怎么选择，都不太可能选一份称心如意的工作安安稳稳一辈子，由于经济环境的不确定，企业的寿命越来越短，现在，人们要经历更多次的职业选择。除此以外，由于人们争先恐后报考热门专业，以致人才饱和，就业困难。而一些新职业的出现，需要新型人才的加入，谁能够及早抓住机会，谁就赢得了机遇。
不要怕犯错，不要害怕走弯路，犯些小错并非坏事，它会增加我们的心灵免疫力。不确定中充满成长的机会，只有不断提升自己的决策能力，才能真正为自己的人生做主。

lines.zh: 最近，小王正为工作的事伤脑筋。毕业于3年前的他，一直做会计，成天和数字打交道，枯燥而且压力大，他做梦都想换一份工作。小王对艺术、心理学都感兴趣，觉得当老师也不错，可他不确定自己真正擅长什么，怕万一选错了，要付出很大的时间成本和经济成本，为此他变得急躁、紧张、顾虑重重。
lines.py: Zuìjìn, Xiǎo Wáng zhèng wèi gōngzuò de shì shāng nǎojīn. Bìyè yú sān nián qián de tā, yìzhí zuò kuàijì, chéngtiān hé shùzì dǎ jiāodao, kūzào érqiě yālì dà, tā zuòmèng dōu xiǎng huàn yí fèn gōngzuò. Xiǎo Wáng duì yìshù, xīnlǐxué dōu gǎn xìngqù, juéde dāng lǎoshī yě búcuò, kě tā bú quèdìng zìjǐ zhēnzhèng shàncháng shénme, pà wànyī xuǎncuò le, yào fùchū hěn dà de shíjiān chéngběn hé jīngjì chéngběn, wèicǐ tā biàn de jízào, jǐnzhāng, gùlǜ chóngchóng.
lines.en: Recently, Xiao Wang has been racking his brains over work. Having graduated three years ago, he has worked as an accountant ever since, dealing with numbers all day long—dull and stressful—and he dreams of changing jobs. Xiao Wang is interested in art and psychology and thinks being a teacher wouldn't be bad either, but he isn't sure what he's really good at, and he's afraid that if he chooses wrong, he'll pay a huge cost in time and money. Because of this he has become impatient, tense and full of misgivings.

lines.zh: 心理专家认为，对自己缺乏信心，对未来过度悲观致使小王出现以上现象。悲观主要包括：我不敢想最坏的结果是什么；我无法承受这个结果；一旦选错，终身悔恨，甚至会觉得人生都没有希望了。其实，类似小王这样的年轻人并非少数。不知道小王们是否读过下面这段对话：
lines.py: Xīnlǐ zhuānjiā rènwéi, duì zìjǐ quēfá xìnxīn, duì wèilái guòdù bēiguān zhìshǐ Xiǎo Wáng chūxiàn yǐshàng xiànxiàng. Bēiguān zhǔyào bāokuò: wǒ bù gǎn xiǎng zuì huài de jiéguǒ shì shénme; wǒ wúfǎ chéngshòu zhège jiéguǒ; yídàn xuǎncuò, zhōngshēn huǐhèn, shènzhì huì juéde rénshēng dōu méiyǒu xīwàng le. Qíshí, lèisì Xiǎo Wáng zhèyàng de niánqīngrén bìngfēi shǎoshù. Bù zhīdào Xiǎo Wángmen shìfǒu dú guo xiàmian zhè duàn duìhuà:
lines.en: Psychologists believe that a lack of self-confidence and excessive pessimism about the future are what cause Xiao Wang's symptoms. The pessimism mainly includes: I don't dare to think what the worst outcome might be; I can't bear that outcome; once I choose wrong, I'll regret it for the rest of my life, and might even feel there's no hope left in life. In fact, young people like Xiao Wang are by no means a minority. I wonder whether all the Xiao Wangs out there have read the following dialogue:

lines.zh: 年轻人：你的智慧从哪里来？
lines.py: Niánqīngrén: Nǐ de zhìhuì cóng nǎli lái?
lines.en: Young man: Where does your wisdom come from?

lines.zh: 乔布斯：来自精确的判断力。
lines.py: Qiáobùsī: Láizì jīngquè de pànduànlì.
lines.en: Steve Jobs: From accurate judgment.

lines.zh: 年轻人：精确的判断力从哪里来？
lines.py: Niánqīngrén: Jīngquè de pànduànlì cóng nǎli lái?
lines.en: Young man: Where does accurate judgment come from?

lines.zh: 乔布斯：来自经验的积累。
lines.py: Qiáobùsī: Láizì jīngyàn de jīlěi.
lines.en: Steve Jobs: From accumulated experience.

lines.zh: 年轻人：那你的经验又从哪里来？
lines.py: Niánqīngrén: Nà nǐ de jīngyàn yòu cóng nǎli lái?
lines.en: Young man: Then where does your experience come from?

lines.zh: 乔布斯：来自无数错误的判断。
lines.py: Qiáobùsī: Láizì wúshù cuòwù de pànduàn.
lines.en: Steve Jobs: From countless wrong judgments.

lines.zh: 做决定是一种能力，而能力不是天生的，是通过实践和挫折得来的，在这个过程中，人同时具有了坚定的意志力和敏锐的判断力，不畏惧付出和失败，勇于承担责任，这就是成长。
lines.py: Zuò juédìng shì yì zhǒng nénglì, ér nénglì bú shì tiānshēng de, shì tōngguò shíjiàn hé cuòzhé dé lai de, zài zhège guòchéng zhōng, rén tóngshí jùyǒu le jiāndìng de yìzhìlì hé mǐnruì de pànduànlì, bú wèijù fùchū hé shībài, yǒngyú chéngdān zérèn, zhè jiù shì chéngzhǎng.
lines.en: Making decisions is a skill, and skills aren't innate—they're gained through practice and setbacks. In the process, a person acquires both firm willpower and keen judgment, isn't afraid of effort or failure, and has the courage to take responsibility. That is what growing up means.

lines.zh: 事实上，伴随着经济全球化，生活中的不确定因素日益增多。昔日风光无限的世界一流企业也会亏损，也会倒闭；一次金融危机，就会使一些连年盈利、运行很好的企业不得不裁员。这意味着，原本英明的决定今天看来可能并非如此了。
lines.py: Shìshí shang, bànsuízhe jīngjì quánqiúhuà, shēnghuó zhōng de bú quèdìng yīnsù rìyì zēngduō. Xīrì fēngguāng wúxiàn de shìjiè yīliú qǐyè yě huì kuīsǔn, yě huì dǎobì; yí cì jīnróng wēijī, jiù huì shǐ yìxiē liánnián yínglì, yùnxíng hěn hǎo de qǐyè bùdébù cáiyuán. Zhè yìwèizhe, yuánběn yīngmíng de juédìng jīntiān kànlai kěnéng bìngfēi rúcǐ le.
lines.en: In fact, with economic globalization, the uncertainties in life are growing day by day. World-class companies that were once at the height of their glory can also lose money and go bankrupt; a single financial crisis can force companies that have been profitable year after year and running well to lay off staff. This means that a decision that once seemed wise may not look so today.

lines.zh: 依我看，无论你怎么选择，都不太可能选一份称心如意的工作安安稳稳一辈子，由于经济环境的不确定，企业的寿命越来越短，现在，人们要经历更多次的职业选择。除此以外，由于人们争先恐后报考热门专业，以致人才饱和，就业困难。而一些新职业的出现，需要新型人才的加入，谁能够及早抓住机会，谁就赢得了机遇。
lines.py: Yī wǒ kàn, wúlùn nǐ zěnme xuǎnzé, dōu bú tài kěnéng xuǎn yí fèn chènxīn rúyì de gōngzuò ān'ān wěnwěn yíbèizi, yóuyú jīngjì huánjìng de bú quèdìng, qǐyè de shòumìng yuè lái yuè duǎn, xiànzài, rénmen yào jīnglì gèng duō cì de zhíyè xuǎnzé. Chú cǐ yǐwài, yóuyú rénmen zhēngxiān kǒnghòu bàokǎo rèmén zhuānyè, yǐzhì réncái bǎohé, jiùyè kùnnan. Ér yìxiē xīn zhíyè de chūxiàn, xūyào xīnxíng réncái de jiārù, shéi nénggòu jízǎo zhuāzhù jīhuì, shéi jiù yíngdé le jīyù.
lines.en: In my view, no matter how you choose, you're unlikely to pick a perfectly satisfying job and stay in it securely for the rest of your life. Because of the uncertain economic environment, companies' lifespans are getting shorter and shorter, and people now have to go through more career choices. Besides that, because people scramble to apply for popular majors, there's a glut of graduates and finding jobs is hard. Meanwhile, the emergence of new professions calls for new kinds of talent, and whoever seizes the chance early wins the opportunity.

lines.zh: 不要怕犯错，不要害怕走弯路，犯些小错并非坏事，它会增加我们的心灵免疫力。不确定中充满成长的机会，只有不断提升自己的决策能力，才能真正为自己的人生做主。
lines.py: Bú yào pà fàn cuò, bú yào hàipà zǒu wānlù, fàn xiē xiǎo cuò bìngfēi huàishì, tā huì zēngjiā wǒmen de xīnlíng miǎnyìlì. Bú quèdìng zhōng chōngmǎn chéngzhǎng de jīhuì, zhǐyǒu búduàn tíshēng zìjǐ de juécè nénglì, cái néng zhēnzhèng wèi zìjǐ de rénshēng zuòzhǔ.
lines.en: Don't be afraid of making mistakes or of taking detours. Making a few small mistakes isn't a bad thing—it strengthens our mental immunity. Uncertainty is full of opportunities to grow, and only by constantly improving our decision-making ability can we truly be the masters of our own lives.

sentences.text: 最近，小王正为工作的事伤脑筋。
悲观主要包括：我不敢想最坏的结果是什么；
我无法承受这个结果；
一旦选错，终身悔恨，甚至会觉得人生都没有希望了。
其实，类似小王这样的年轻人并非少数。
不知道小王们是否读过下面这段对话：
年轻人：你的智慧从哪里来？
乔布斯：来自精确的判断力。
年轻人：精确的判断力从哪里来？
乔布斯：来自经验的积累。
年轻人：那你的经验又从哪里来？
乔布斯：来自无数错误的判断。
昔日风光无限的世界一流企业也会亏损，也会倒闭；
这意味着，原本英明的决定今天看来可能并非如此了。
除此以外，由于人们争先恐后报考热门专业，以致人才饱和，就业困难。

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
如果有一天，你看到自己婴儿时期的一张照片，你能认出自己吗？
也许你会一下子认出自己，因为你觉得你一直都是你，但实际上，从拍照片的那一刻起，你的身上已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。比如说，你的皮肤自你出生以来已经被更新130多次了。你的酒窝不见了，5岁那年，你从高处往下蹦，跌倒了，脸上留下的疤痕掩盖了它。你的大脑已经比拍照时增加了2～3倍的重量。
如果你确信你就是你，不管怎样变化，那么，照片上的婴儿到底是不是你？是现在的你，还是一个不同的过去的你？如果是过去的你，那么，有多少个过去的你？是不是还会有更多的不同的你？你用电脑生成了一张你50岁时的图片，对你而言，就像看一个陌生人。
有关本体的问题，困扰了哲学家2500多年。什么是本体？这里说的本体就是我们的思想或身体。
赫拉克利特把自我比喻为一条河，河流流动时会呈现出不同的状态，但它始终是固有的那条河。他将自己的观点阐述为：不管你变化了多少，始终只有一个你。
大卫·休谟不同意“连续的自我”的观点。他是这样陈述自己的见解的：“我们的思想，是连续不断的认知组成的演变过程”。而你可以推测，譬如，婴儿大卫的油画呈现的是一个与成年大卫类似的人，并非完全相同。
哲学家们对本体的问题各抒己见，我们却在想一些更为实际的问题，假如休谟是对的，那么从现在开始，10年后你就会成为另一个人，你还需要遵守现在的你做出的承诺吗？或者说，一个被通缉了15年的罪犯，今天还应该为当初触犯法律的行为受到惩罚吗？
我们每个人都会发生变化。譬如，你去整形，你因为过于忧郁而吃药，你做心、肺或者其他器官移植手术，这些都会逐渐改变你的面貌、情绪和行为，你还是你吗？
德里克·帕菲特有一个极端得空前绝后的假设，例如将他的大脑一分为二，移植进另外两个身体中，两个人术后从昏迷中清醒过来，都会认为：“我是德里克。”但是，德里克不可能是两个人，他也不可能只是其中的一个。由此，他得出结论：“个人的本体并不是真正重要的事情。”
不瞒你说，对这个问题，我是这样想的：哲学家们的言论、学说离我们十分遥远，我们不会陷入本体的思索，我们也不会设想将大脑移植给两个人，那简直就是拿自己的性命开玩笑，我们只想无忧无虑地过日子。可是，会不会有一天，你醒来，感觉今天的我不像原来的我，而像是一个崭新的我了呢？

lines.zh: 如果有一天，你看到自己婴儿时期的一张照片，你能认出自己吗？
lines.py: Rúguǒ yǒu yì tiān, nǐ kàndào zìjǐ yīng'ér shíqī de yì zhāng zhàopiàn, nǐ néng rènchū zìjǐ ma?
lines.en: If one day you saw a photo of yourself as a baby, would you recognize yourself?

lines.zh: 也许你会一下子认出自己，因为你觉得你一直都是你，但实际上，从拍照片的那一刻起，你的身上已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。比如说，你的皮肤自你出生以来已经被更新130多次了。你的酒窝不见了，5岁那年，你从高处往下蹦，跌倒了，脸上留下的疤痕掩盖了它。你的大脑已经比拍照时增加了2～3倍的重量。
lines.py: Yěxǔ nǐ huì yíxiàzi rènchū zìjǐ, yīnwèi nǐ juéde nǐ yìzhí dōu shì nǐ, dàn shíjì shang, cóng pāi zhàopiàn de nà yí kè qǐ, nǐ de shēn shang yǐjīng fāshēng le fāntiān fùdì de biànhuà. Bǐrú shuō, nǐ de pífū zì nǐ chūshēng yǐlái yǐjīng bèi gēngxīn yìbǎi sānshí duō cì le. Nǐ de jiǔwō bú jiàn le, wǔ suì nà nián, nǐ cóng gāochù wǎng xià bèng, diēdǎo le, liǎn shang liúxia de bāhén yǎngài le tā. Nǐ de dànǎo yǐjīng bǐ pāizhào shí zēngjiā le liǎng dào sān bèi de zhòngliàng.
lines.en: Maybe you'd recognize yourself right away, because you feel you've always been you. But in fact, from the moment that photo was taken, your body has undergone earth-shaking changes. For example, your skin has been renewed more than 130 times since you were born. Your dimple is gone: the year you were five, you jumped down from a high place and fell, and the scar left on your face covered it up. Your brain is now two to three times heavier than when the photo was taken.

lines.zh: 如果你确信你就是你，不管怎样变化，那么，照片上的婴儿到底是不是你？是现在的你，还是一个不同的过去的你？如果是过去的你，那么，有多少个过去的你？是不是还会有更多的不同的你？你用电脑生成了一张你50岁时的图片，对你而言，就像看一个陌生人。
lines.py: Rúguǒ nǐ quèxìn nǐ jiù shì nǐ, bùguǎn zěnyàng biànhuà, nàme, zhàopiàn shang de yīng'ér dàodǐ shì bu shì nǐ? Shì xiànzài de nǐ, háishi yí ge bùtóng de guòqù de nǐ? Rúguǒ shì guòqù de nǐ, nàme, yǒu duōshao ge guòqù de nǐ? Shì bu shì hái huì yǒu gèng duō de bùtóng de nǐ? Nǐ yòng diànnǎo shēngchéng le yì zhāng nǐ wǔshí suì shí de túpiàn, duì nǐ ér yán, jiù xiàng kàn yí ge mòshēngrén.
lines.en: If you're sure that you are you, no matter how you change, then is the baby in the photo really you or not? Is it the present you, or a different, past you? If it's a past you, then how many past yous are there? Could there be even more different yous? If you used a computer to generate a picture of yourself at fifty, it would be like looking at a stranger.

lines.zh: 有关本体的问题，困扰了哲学家2500多年。什么是本体？这里说的本体就是我们的思想或身体。
lines.py: Yǒuguān běntǐ de wèntí, kùnrǎo le zhéxuéjiā liǎngqiān wǔbǎi duō nián. Shénme shì běntǐ? Zhèli shuō de běntǐ jiù shì wǒmen de sīxiǎng huò shēntǐ.
lines.en: The question of identity has puzzled philosophers for more than 2,500 years. What is identity? Identity here means our mind or our body.

lines.zh: 赫拉克利特把自我比喻为一条河，河流流动时会呈现出不同的状态，但它始终是固有的那条河。他将自己的观点阐述为：不管你变化了多少，始终只有一个你。
lines.py: Hèlākèlìtè bǎ zìwǒ bǐyù wéi yì tiáo hé, héliú liúdòng shí huì chéngxiàn chū bùtóng de zhuàngtài, dàn tā shǐzhōng shì gùyǒu de nà tiáo hé. Tā jiāng zìjǐ de guāndiǎn chǎnshù wéi: bùguǎn nǐ biànhuà le duōshao, shǐzhōng zhǐyǒu yí ge nǐ.
lines.en: Heraclitus compared the self to a river: as a river flows it takes on different states, but it is always the same river. He expressed his view this way: no matter how much you change, there is always only one you.

lines.zh: 大卫·休谟不同意“连续的自我”的观点。他是这样陈述自己的见解的：“我们的思想，是连续不断的认知组成的演变过程”。而你可以推测，譬如，婴儿大卫的油画呈现的是一个与成年大卫类似的人，并非完全相同。
lines.py: Dàwèi Xiūmó bù tóngyì "liánxù de zìwǒ" de guāndiǎn. Tā shì zhèyàng chénshù zìjǐ de jiànjiě de: "Wǒmen de sīxiǎng, shì liánxù búduàn de rènzhī zǔchéng de yǎnbiàn guòchéng". Ér nǐ kěyǐ tuīcè, pìrú, yīng'ér Dàwèi de yóuhuà chéngxiàn de shì yí ge yǔ chéngnián Dàwèi lèisì de rén, bìngfēi wánquán xiāngtóng.
lines.en: David Hume disagreed with the idea of a "continuous self". He stated his view like this: "Our minds are an evolving process made up of an unbroken series of perceptions." And you could infer, for example, that an oil painting of baby David shows a person similar to the adult David, but not exactly the same.

lines.zh: 哲学家们对本体的问题各抒己见，我们却在想一些更为实际的问题，假如休谟是对的，那么从现在开始，10年后你就会成为另一个人，你还需要遵守现在的你做出的承诺吗？或者说，一个被通缉了15年的罪犯，今天还应该为当初触犯法律的行为受到惩罚吗？
lines.py: Zhéxuéjiāmen duì běntǐ de wèntí gè shū jǐ jiàn, wǒmen què zài xiǎng yìxiē gèng wéi shíjì de wèntí, jiǎrú Xiūmó shì duì de, nàme cóng xiànzài kāishǐ, shí nián hòu nǐ jiù huì chéngwéi lìng yí ge rén, nǐ hái xūyào zūnshǒu xiànzài de nǐ zuòchū de chéngnuò ma? Huòzhě shuō, yí ge bèi tōngjī le shíwǔ nián de zuìfàn, jīntiān hái yīnggāi wèi dāngchū chùfàn fǎlǜ de xíngwéi shòudào chéngfá ma?
lines.en: Philosophers each have their own views on the question of identity, but we're thinking about more practical questions. If Hume is right, then ten years from now you'll become another person—will you still need to keep promises made by the present you? Or, should a criminal who has been wanted for fifteen years still be punished today for breaking the law back then?

lines.zh: 我们每个人都会发生变化。譬如，你去整形，你因为过于忧郁而吃药，你做心、肺或者其他器官移植手术，这些都会逐渐改变你的面貌、情绪和行为，你还是你吗？
lines.py: Wǒmen měi ge rén dōu huì fāshēng biànhuà. Pìrú, nǐ qù zhěngxíng, nǐ yīnwèi guòyú yōuyù ér chī yào, nǐ zuò xīn, fèi huòzhě qítā qìguān yízhí shǒushù, zhèxiē dōu huì zhújiàn gǎibiàn nǐ de miànmào, qíngxù hé xíngwéi, nǐ hái shì nǐ ma?
lines.en: Every one of us changes. For example, if you have plastic surgery, take medication because you're too depressed, or have a heart, lung or other organ transplant, all of these will gradually change your appearance, emotions and behavior. Are you still you?

lines.zh: 德里克·帕菲特有一个极端得空前绝后的假设，例如将他的大脑一分为二，移植进另外两个身体中，两个人术后从昏迷中清醒过来，都会认为：“我是德里克。”但是，德里克不可能是两个人，他也不可能只是其中的一个。由此，他得出结论：“个人的本体并不是真正重要的事情。”
lines.py: Délǐkè Pàfēitè yǒu yí ge jíduān de kōngqián juéhòu de jiǎshè, lìrú jiāng tā de dànǎo yì fēn wéi èr, yízhí jìn lìngwài liǎng ge shēntǐ zhōng, liǎng ge rén shù hòu cóng hūnmí zhōng qīngxǐng guolai, dōu huì rènwéi: "Wǒ shì Délǐkè." Dànshì, Délǐkè bù kěnéng shì liǎng ge rén, tā yě bù kěnéng zhǐ shì qízhōng de yí ge. Yóucǐ, tā déchū jiélùn: "Gèrén de běntǐ bìng bú shì zhēnzhèng zhòngyào de shìqing."
lines.en: Derek Parfit proposed a hypothesis more extreme than any before or since: for example, split his brain in two and transplant the halves into two other bodies. When the two people woke from the anesthesia after surgery, both would think, "I am Derek." But Derek can't be two people, nor can he be just one of them. From this he concluded: "Personal identity is not what really matters."

lines.zh: 不瞒你说，对这个问题，我是这样想的：哲学家们的言论、学说离我们十分遥远，我们不会陷入本体的思索，我们也不会设想将大脑移植给两个人，那简直就是拿自己的性命开玩笑，我们只想无忧无虑地过日子。可是，会不会有一天，你醒来，感觉今天的我不像原来的我，而像是一个崭新的我了呢？
lines.py: Bù mán nǐ shuō, duì zhège wèntí, wǒ shì zhèyàng xiǎng de: zhéxuéjiāmen de yánlùn, xuéshuō lí wǒmen shífēn yáoyuǎn, wǒmen bú huì xiànrù běntǐ de sīsuǒ, wǒmen yě bú huì shèxiǎng jiāng dànǎo yízhí gěi liǎng ge rén, nà jiǎnzhí jiù shì ná zìjǐ de xìngmìng kāi wánxiào, wǒmen zhǐ xiǎng wúyōu wúlǜ de guò rìzi. Kěshì, huì bu huì yǒu yì tiān, nǐ xǐnglai, gǎnjué jīntiān de wǒ bú xiàng yuánlái de wǒ, ér xiàng shì yí ge zhǎnxīn de wǒ le ne?
lines.en: To be honest with you, this is what I think about the question: the philosophers' arguments and theories are very far removed from us. We won't get bogged down pondering identity, and we won't imagine transplanting our brain into two people—that would be gambling with our lives. We just want to live carefree. But might there come a day when you wake up and feel that today's me isn't like the old me, but like a brand-new me?

sentences.text: 你的大脑已经比拍照时增加了2～3倍的重量。
是现在的你，还是一个不同的过去的你？
如果是过去的你，那么，有多少个过去的你？
是不是还会有更多的不同的你？
什么是本体？
这里说的本体就是我们的思想或身体。
大卫·休谟不同意“连续的自我”的观点。
我们每个人都会发生变化。

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
开会时老板火了：“别假装正经，我知道你们都在玩儿手机，那玩意儿就那么好玩儿？”
老板指着我：“你说说，看了什么？比我说话还有意思？”
我脸臊得通红，说：“一对年轻人边开车边拿手机拍照，把桥撞坏了，没报警，先下车拍照发微信。要不要转发给您？”
老板一摆手：“你们呀，都让手机给绑架了，这么过日子，不受罪吗？”
一同事举手：“老板，刚搜索了一下，离不开手机也是一种精神病。”
老板大吼：“有病就得治！”，随后黑着脸扔下一句话：“以后开会谁都不许带手机！”
老板说的没错，特别是有了智能手机，我就成了手机的奴隶，对什么都麻木了，心里只有手机：三分钟看一次新闻；十分钟发一次微信；吃饭前先拍照；狼吞虎咽吃完，又埋头看微信；睡觉之前先给手机充电……把手机它老人家伺候得好好的。有一次阿毛对我说：“我跟你说话呢，你干吗老看手机？”。我冲他眨眨眼，说：“那你也拿出手机，咱们手机上聊吧，保证不分心！”
离开了手机，难道会死吗？何不尝试一下一周关机一天？说干就干，索性这礼拜就开始。
周日，我按小学生的作息时间七点起床，之后，先着手安置我的手机。为了防止自己意志薄弱，我找来个精致的盒子，把手机层层包好，庄重地放在盒子里，收到衣柜最里面。为了分散注意力，我决定去公园锻炼我那僵硬的四肢，因为迷上智能手机以后，我已经好久不锻炼了。
公园里唱的跳的都有。跳舞是我的特长，我兴高采烈地跳起了摇滚，既能娱乐身心，又能锻炼身体，一举两得。
跳完舞，我往家走，突然想起被冷落了半天儿的手机，急忙赶回家，打开衣柜，手机还在，我心里踏实了许多。五个小时没碰它，我心空虚得要命，我决定用熬粥这件最消耗时间的事来弥补心中的空虚。烧水，下米，看着雪白的米在沸腾的水中翻滚，屋子里渐渐弥漫着粥的香气，屋外竟然传来了鸟的叫声，我的心慢慢静了下来。要在往常，我一定早待不住了，惦记着某某侦探的案件是不是有了突破，科学家是否有了震惊世界的发现，彩票大奖开了没有，前两天的恐怖袭击到底是谁干的……
没有手机的干扰，生活这么安宁，我突然有了一种回归生活的欣慰。

lines.zh: 开会时老板火了：“别假装正经，我知道你们都在玩儿手机，那玩意儿就那么好玩儿？”
lines.py: Kāihuì shí lǎobǎn huǒ le: "Bié jiǎzhuāng zhèngjing, wǒ zhīdào nǐmen dōu zài wánr shǒujī, nà wányìr jiù nàme hǎowánr?"
lines.en: During the meeting the boss blew up: "Stop pretending to be serious. I know you're all playing on your phones—are those things really that much fun?"

lines.zh: 老板指着我：“你说说，看了什么？比我说话还有意思？”
lines.py: Lǎobǎn zhǐzhe wǒ: "Nǐ shuōshuo, kàn le shénme? Bǐ wǒ shuōhuà hái yǒu yìsi?"
lines.en: The boss pointed at me: "You tell me—what were you looking at? Is it more interesting than what I'm saying?"

lines.zh: 我脸臊得通红，说：“一对年轻人边开车边拿手机拍照，把桥撞坏了，没报警，先下车拍照发微信。要不要转发给您？”
lines.py: Wǒ liǎn sào de tōnghóng, shuō: "Yí duì niánqīngrén biān kāichē biān ná shǒujī pāizhào, bǎ qiáo zhuànghuài le, méi bàojǐng, xiān xià chē pāizhào fā Wēixìn. Yào bu yào zhuǎnfā gěi nín?"
lines.en: My face turned bright red with embarrassment, and I said, "A young couple were taking photos on their phone while driving and crashed into a bridge and damaged it. Instead of calling the police, they first got out of the car to take pictures and post them on WeChat. Would you like me to forward it to you?"

lines.zh: 老板一摆手：“你们呀，都让手机给绑架了，这么过日子，不受罪吗？”
lines.py: Lǎobǎn yì bǎishǒu: "Nǐmen ya, dōu ràng shǒujī gěi bǎngjià le, zhème guò rìzi, bú shòuzuì ma?"
lines.en: The boss waved his hand: "You lot have all been kidnapped by your phones. Isn't living like this torture?"

lines.zh: 一同事举手：“老板，刚搜索了一下，离不开手机也是一种精神病。”
lines.py: Yì tóngshì jǔshǒu: "Lǎobǎn, gāng sōusuǒ le yíxià, lí bu kāi shǒujī yě shì yì zhǒng jīngshénbìng."
lines.en: A colleague raised his hand: "Boss, I just searched it—not being able to live without your phone is actually a mental illness."

lines.zh: 老板大吼：“有病就得治！”，随后黑着脸扔下一句话：“以后开会谁都不许带手机！”
lines.py: Lǎobǎn dà hǒu: "Yǒu bìng jiù děi zhì!", suíhòu hēizhe liǎn rēngxia yí jù huà: "Yǐhòu kāihuì shéi dōu bù xǔ dài shǒujī!"
lines.en: The boss roared, "If you're sick, you need treatment!" Then, with a dark face, he threw out one last line: "From now on, nobody is allowed to bring a phone to meetings!"

lines.zh: 老板说的没错，特别是有了智能手机，我就成了手机的奴隶，对什么都麻木了，心里只有手机：三分钟看一次新闻；十分钟发一次微信；吃饭前先拍照；狼吞虎咽吃完，又埋头看微信；睡觉之前先给手机充电……把手机它老人家伺候得好好的。有一次阿毛对我说：“我跟你说话呢，你干吗老看手机？”。我冲他眨眨眼，说：“那你也拿出手机，咱们手机上聊吧，保证不分心！”
lines.py: Lǎobǎn shuō de méi cuò, tèbié shì yǒu le zhìnéng shǒujī, wǒ jiù chéng le shǒujī de núlì, duì shénme dōu mámù le, xīnli zhǐyǒu shǒujī: sān fēnzhōng kàn yí cì xīnwén; shí fēnzhōng fā yí cì Wēixìn; chīfàn qián xiān pāizhào; lángtūn hǔyàn chīwán, yòu máitóu kàn Wēixìn; shuìjiào zhīqián xiān gěi shǒujī chōngdiàn…… bǎ shǒujī tā lǎorénjia cìhou de hǎohǎo de. Yǒu yí cì Ā Máo duì wǒ shuō: "Wǒ gēn nǐ shuōhuà ne, nǐ gànmá lǎo kàn shǒujī?". Wǒ chòng tā zhǎzha yǎn, shuō: "Nà nǐ yě náchū shǒujī, zánmen shǒujī shang liáo ba, bǎozhèng bù fēnxīn!"
lines.en: The boss was right. Especially since I got a smartphone, I've become a slave to it, numb to everything else, with nothing on my mind but my phone: I check the news every three minutes; post on WeChat every ten minutes; take photos before every meal; wolf down my food and then bury my head in WeChat again; charge my phone before going to bed... I wait on my phone hand and foot like an elderly master. Once A Mao said to me, "I'm talking to you—why do you keep looking at your phone?" I winked at him and said, "Then take out your phone too, and let's chat on our phones—I guarantee I won't be distracted!"

lines.zh: 离开了手机，难道会死吗？何不尝试一下一周关机一天？说干就干，索性这礼拜就开始。
lines.py: Líkāi le shǒujī, nándào huì sǐ ma? Hé bù chángshì yíxià yì zhōu guānjī yì tiān? Shuō gàn jiù gàn, suǒxìng zhè lǐbài jiù kāishǐ.
lines.en: Would I really die without my phone? Why not try switching it off one day a week? No sooner said than done—I might as well start this week.

lines.zh: 周日，我按小学生的作息时间七点起床，之后，先着手安置我的手机。为了防止自己意志薄弱，我找来个精致的盒子，把手机层层包好，庄重地放在盒子里，收到衣柜最里面。为了分散注意力，我决定去公园锻炼我那僵硬的四肢，因为迷上智能手机以后，我已经好久不锻炼了。
lines.py: Zhōurì, wǒ àn xiǎoxuéshēng de zuòxī shíjiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng, zhīhòu, xiān zhuóshǒu ānzhì wǒ de shǒujī. Wèile fángzhǐ zìjǐ yìzhì bóruò, wǒ zhǎolai ge jīngzhì de hézi, bǎ shǒujī céngcéng bāohǎo, zhuāngzhòng de fàng zài hézi li, shōudào yīguì zuì lǐmian. Wèile fēnsàn zhùyìlì, wǒ juédìng qù gōngyuán duànliàn wǒ nà jiāngyìng de sìzhī, yīnwèi míshang zhìnéng shǒujī yǐhòu, wǒ yǐjīng hǎojiǔ bú duànliàn le.
lines.en: On Sunday, I got up at seven, following a primary schoolchild's schedule, and then first set about dealing with my phone. To guard against my own weak willpower, I found an exquisite box, wrapped the phone up layer by layer, solemnly placed it in the box, and put it away at the very back of the wardrobe. To distract myself, I decided to go to the park to exercise my stiff limbs, because since getting hooked on my smartphone I hadn't exercised for a long time.

lines.zh: 公园里唱的跳的都有。跳舞是我的特长，我兴高采烈地跳起了摇滚，既能娱乐身心，又能锻炼身体，一举两得。
lines.py: Gōngyuán li chàng de tiào de dōu yǒu. Tiàowǔ shì wǒ de tècháng, wǒ xìnggāo cǎiliè de tiàoqǐ le yáogǔn, jì néng yúlè shēnxīn, yòu néng duànliàn shēntǐ, yì jǔ liǎng dé.
lines.en: In the park there were people singing and dancing. Dancing is my specialty, so I happily started dancing to rock music. It entertained body and mind and gave me exercise at the same time—killing two birds with one stone.

lines.zh: 跳完舞，我往家走，突然想起被冷落了半天儿的手机，急忙赶回家，打开衣柜，手机还在，我心里踏实了许多。五个小时没碰它，我心空虚得要命，我决定用熬粥这件最消耗时间的事来弥补心中的空虚。烧水，下米，看着雪白的米在沸腾的水中翻滚，屋子里渐渐弥漫着粥的香气，屋外竟然传来了鸟的叫声，我的心慢慢静了下来。要在往常，我一定早待不住了，惦记着某某侦探的案件是不是有了突破，科学家是否有了震惊世界的发现，彩票大奖开了没有，前两天的恐怖袭击到底是谁干的……
lines.py: Tiàowán wǔ, wǒ wǎng jiā zǒu, tūrán xiǎngqǐ bèi lěngluò le bàntiānr de shǒujī, jímáng gǎnhuí jiā, dǎkāi yīguì, shǒujī hái zài, wǒ xīnli tāshi le xǔduō. Wǔ ge xiǎoshí méi pèng tā, wǒ xīn kōngxū de yàomìng, wǒ juédìng yòng áo zhōu zhè jiàn zuì xiāohào shíjiān de shì lái míbǔ xīnzhōng de kōngxū. Shāo shuǐ, xià mǐ, kànzhe xuěbái de mǐ zài fèiténg de shuǐ zhōng fāngǔn, wūzi li jiànjiàn mímànzhe zhōu de xiāngqì, wū wài jìngrán chuánlai le niǎo de jiàoshēng, wǒ de xīn mànmàn jìng le xialai. Yào zài wǎngcháng, wǒ yídìng zǎo dāi bu zhù le, diànjizhe mǒumǒu zhēntàn de ànjiàn shì bu shì yǒu le tūpò, kēxuéjiā shìfǒu yǒu le zhènjīng shìjiè de fāxiàn, cǎipiào dàjiǎng kāi le méiyǒu, qián liǎng tiān de kǒngbù xíjī dàodǐ shì shéi gàn de……
lines.en: After dancing, I headed home and suddenly remembered the phone I'd neglected for half the day. I hurried back, opened the wardrobe, and the phone was still there—I felt much more at ease. Not having touched it for five hours, I felt terribly empty inside, so I decided to fill the emptiness by making congee, the most time-consuming thing I could think of. I boiled water, added rice, and watched the snow-white rice tumbling in the bubbling water. The fragrance of congee gradually filled the room, and to my surprise I heard birds singing outside, and my heart slowly calmed down. Normally I would have long since been unable to sit still, wondering whether some detective's case had had a breakthrough, whether scientists had made a world-shaking discovery, whether the lottery jackpot had been drawn, and who was behind the terrorist attack a couple of days ago...

lines.zh: 没有手机的干扰，生活这么安宁，我突然有了一种回归生活的欣慰。
lines.py: Méiyǒu shǒujī de gānrǎo, shēnghuó zhème ānníng, wǒ tūrán yǒu le yì zhǒng huíguī shēnghuó de xīnwèi.
lines.en: Without the distraction of my phone, life was so peaceful, and I suddenly felt the comfort of returning to real life.

sentences.text: 老板指着我：“你说说，看了什么？
比我说话还有意思？”
要不要转发给您？”
老板大吼：“有病就得治！”
十分钟发一次微信；
吃饭前先拍照；
狼吞虎咽吃完，又埋头看微信；
离开了手机，难道会死吗？
何不尝试一下一周关机一天？
说干就干，索性这礼拜就开始。

lessons.name: 全球化视野中的中国饮食

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
任何一个民族的饮食都不仅仅为饮食，它蕴藏着这个民族的精神与特征，传达着这个民族的文化传统。中国的饮食文化历经数千年，始终具有魅力，是因为它不仅民族特性鲜明，而且善于吸收不同国家、不同区域、不同民族的优异之处，以至辉煌至今。
中国文化的核心是一个“和”字。“和”包含“中和”“和谐”之意。“中和”的意思就是折中、调和性质不同的事物。
原本中华饮食中的大量食物来自辽阔的土地、高山上的飞禽走兽，湖泊、小溪中的一条鱼，丘陵上种植的一棵菜，经过精心构思，巧妙烹饪，即便仅为一餐素食，也可以让你尽享人间美味。汉唐以后，中亚及东南亚的食物进入了中华饮食体系，极大地丰富了中国食物的品种；近代，西方饮食思想与方式得到认可，具有现代特征的中华饮食形态逐渐形成。
在食材栽培方面，中华饮食坚持以本国物产为基本原料，同时合理引进、培育外来品种，比如咖啡、柠檬、芒果等，凡是历史不够悠久的外来食品，人们一般从食物名称上就能立即清晰地分辨出它的洋身份。至于中餐中使用频率最高的葱、姜、蒜等调料，因其进入中华饮食年代久远，许多中国人甚至把它当成了正宗的中国食材。在加工过程中，中国人照样可以用中国方式烹饪外来食材，使它美味诱人。而这一切得力于中国人能够充分认识异域食物的内在价值，以开放性的思维和灵感，创新式地把外来食物改变为中国饮食成分。
在就餐方式上，中华饮食文化同样显示着不排斥异域文化的态度，比如中餐“合餐制”的形成。先秦至唐代，中国采用分餐式方式就餐。南北朝时期，一种可随意折起来、称作胡床的坐具和一种较大的餐桌开始在中原地区流行，这些器具的推广，打破了跪坐而食的局限，形成了围坐合餐的形式。当然，对“合餐制”的全面接受与文化认同，根本上与“和”文化是相通的。
可以说，中华饮食文化自诞生之日起，就面向世界，边继承、边改革，不断引进新元素，这也是其充满活力的奥秘所在。

lines.zh: 任何一个民族的饮食都不仅仅为饮食，它蕴藏着这个民族的精神与特征，传达着这个民族的文化传统。中国的饮食文化历经数千年，始终具有魅力，是因为它不仅民族特性鲜明，而且善于吸收不同国家、不同区域、不同民族的优异之处，以至辉煌至今。
lines.py: Rènhé yí ge mínzú de yǐnshí dōu bù jǐnjǐn wèi yǐnshí, tā yùncángzhe zhège mínzú de jīngshén yǔ tèzhēng, chuándázhe zhège mínzú de wénhuà chuántǒng. Zhōngguó de yǐnshí wénhuà lìjīng shù qiān nián, shǐzhōng jùyǒu mèilì, shì yīnwèi tā bùjǐn mínzú tèxìng xiānmíng, érqiě shànyú xīshōu bùtóng guójiā, bùtóng qūyù, bùtóng mínzú de yōuyì zhī chù, yǐzhì huīhuáng zhìjīn.
lines.en: The food and drink of any nation is never merely food and drink; it holds the spirit and character of that nation and conveys its cultural traditions. Chinese food culture has endured for thousands of years and remained appealing throughout because it not only has a distinct national character but is also good at absorbing the strengths of different countries, regions and ethnic groups, which is why it remains brilliant to this day.

lines.zh: 中国文化的核心是一个“和”字。“和”包含“中和”“和谐”之意。“中和”的意思就是折中、调和性质不同的事物。
lines.py: Zhōngguó wénhuà de héxīn shì yí ge "hé" zì. "Hé" bāohán "zhōnghé" "héxié" zhī yì. "Zhōnghé" de yìsi jiùshì zhézhōng, tiáohé xìngzhì bùtóng de shìwù.
lines.en: The core of Chinese culture is the single character "he" (harmony). "He" contains the meanings of "balance" and "harmony". "Balance" means finding a middle ground between, and reconciling, things of different natures.

lines.zh: 原本中华饮食中的大量食物来自辽阔的土地、高山上的飞禽走兽，湖泊、小溪中的一条鱼，丘陵上种植的一棵菜，经过精心构思，巧妙烹饪，即便仅为一餐素食，也可以让你尽享人间美味。汉唐以后，中亚及东南亚的食物进入了中华饮食体系，极大地丰富了中国食物的品种；近代，西方饮食思想与方式得到认可，具有现代特征的中华饮食形态逐渐形成。
lines.py: Yuánběn Zhōnghuá yǐnshí zhōng de dàliàng shíwù láizì liáokuò de tǔdì, gāoshān shang de fēiqín zǒushòu, húpō, xiǎoxī zhōng de yì tiáo yú, qiūlíng shang zhòngzhí de yì kē cài, jīngguò jīngxīn gòusī, qiǎomiào pēngrèn, jíbiàn jǐn wéi yì cān sùshí, yě kěyǐ ràng nǐ jǐn xiǎng rénjiān měiwèi. Hàn Táng yǐhòu, Zhōngyà jí Dōngnányà de shíwù jìnrùle Zhōnghuá yǐnshí tǐxì, jí dà de fēngfùle Zhōngguó shíwù de pǐnzhǒng; jìndài, Xīfāng yǐnshí sīxiǎng yǔ fāngshì dédào rènkě, jùyǒu xiàndài tèzhēng de Zhōnghuá yǐnshí xíngtài zhújiàn xíngchéng.
lines.en: Originally, much of the food in Chinese cuisine came from the vast land and from the birds and beasts of the high mountains: a fish from a lake or stream, a vegetable grown on the hills. Through careful planning and skillful cooking, even a single vegetarian meal can let you fully enjoy the finest flavors in the world. After the Han and Tang dynasties, foods from Central and Southeast Asia entered the Chinese food system, greatly enriching the variety of Chinese food; in modern times, Western ideas and ways of eating gained acceptance, and a form of Chinese cuisine with modern features gradually took shape.

lines.zh: 在食材栽培方面，中华饮食坚持以本国物产为基本原料，同时合理引进、培育外来品种，比如咖啡、柠檬、芒果等，凡是历史不够悠久的外来食品，人们一般从食物名称上就能立即清晰地分辨出它的洋身份。至于中餐中使用频率最高的葱、姜、蒜等调料，因其进入中华饮食年代久远，许多中国人甚至把它当成了正宗的中国食材。在加工过程中，中国人照样可以用中国方式烹饪外来食材，使它美味诱人。而这一切得力于中国人能够充分认识异域食物的内在价值，以开放性的思维和灵感，创新式地把外来食物改变为中国饮食成分。
lines.py: Zài shícái zāipéi fāngmiàn, Zhōnghuá yǐnshí jiānchí yǐ běnguó wùchǎn wéi jīběn yuánliào, tóngshí hélǐ yǐnjìn, péiyù wàilái pǐnzhǒng, bǐrú kāfēi, níngméng, mángguǒ děng, fánshì lìshǐ bú gòu yōujiǔ de wàilái shípǐn, rénmen yìbān cóng shíwù míngchēng shang jiù néng lìjí qīngxī de fēnbiàn chū tā de yáng shēnfen. Zhìyú zhōngcān zhōng shǐyòng pínlǜ zuì gāo de cōng, jiāng, suàn děng tiáoliào, yīn qí jìnrù Zhōnghuá yǐnshí niándài jiǔyuǎn, xǔduō Zhōngguórén shènzhì bǎ tā dàngchéngle zhèngzōng de Zhōngguó shícái. Zài jiāgōng guòchéng zhōng, Zhōngguórén zhàoyàng kěyǐ yòng Zhōngguó fāngshì pēngrèn wàilái shícái, shǐ tā měiwèi yòurén. Ér zhè yíqiè délì yú Zhōngguórén nénggòu chōngfèn rènshi yìyù shíwù de nèizài jiàzhí, yǐ kāifàngxìng de sīwéi hé línggǎn, chuàngxīnshì de bǎ wàilái shíwù gǎibiàn wéi Zhōngguó yǐnshí chéngfèn.
lines.en: In growing ingredients, Chinese cuisine holds to domestic produce as its basic raw material while sensibly introducing and cultivating foreign varieties, such as coffee, lemons and mangoes. For any foreign food without a long enough history, people can usually tell its foreign identity immediately and clearly from its name. As for the most frequently used seasonings in Chinese cooking, such as scallions, ginger and garlic, they entered Chinese cuisine so long ago that many Chinese even regard them as authentic Chinese ingredients. In preparation, Chinese people can just as well cook foreign ingredients the Chinese way and make them delicious and tempting. All this is thanks to the Chinese being able to fully recognize the intrinsic value of foreign foods and, with open thinking and inspiration, creatively turning them into part of Chinese cuisine.

lines.zh: 在就餐方式上，中华饮食文化同样显示着不排斥异域文化的态度，比如中餐“合餐制”的形成。先秦至唐代，中国采用分餐式方式就餐。南北朝时期，一种可随意折起来、称作胡床的坐具和一种较大的餐桌开始在中原地区流行，这些器具的推广，打破了跪坐而食的局限，形成了围坐合餐的形式。当然，对“合餐制”的全面接受与文化认同，根本上与“和”文化是相通的。
lines.py: Zài jiùcān fāngshì shang, Zhōnghuá yǐnshí wénhuà tóngyàng xiǎnshìzhe bù páichì yìyù wénhuà de tàidu, bǐrú zhōngcān "hécānzhì" de xíngchéng. Xiān Qín zhì Tángdài, Zhōngguó cǎiyòng fēncānshì fāngshì jiùcān. Nán-Běi Cháo shíqī, yì zhǒng kě suíyì zhé qilai, chēngzuò húchuáng de zuòjù hé yì zhǒng jiào dà de cānzhuō kāishǐ zài Zhōngyuán dìqū liúxíng, zhèxiē qìjù de tuīguǎng, dǎpòle guìzuò ér shí de júxiàn, xíngchéngle wéizuò hécān de xíngshì. Dāngrán, duì "hécānzhì" de quánmiàn jiēshòu yǔ wénhuà rèntóng, gēnběn shang yǔ "hé" wénhuà shì xiāngtōng de.
lines.en: In the way meals are eaten, Chinese food culture likewise shows an attitude of not rejecting foreign cultures, for example in the formation of the Chinese "shared-dish system". From the pre-Qin period to the Tang dynasty, the Chinese ate with separate individual portions. During the Northern and Southern Dynasties, a folding seat called the "huchuang" and a larger dining table became popular in the Central Plains. The spread of this furniture broke the constraint of kneeling to eat and gave rise to sitting around a table and sharing dishes. Of course, the full acceptance and cultural embrace of the shared-dish system is fundamentally connected with the culture of "harmony".

lines.zh: 可以说，中华饮食文化自诞生之日起，就面向世界，边继承、边改革，不断引进新元素，这也是其充满活力的奥秘所在。
lines.py: Kěyǐ shuō, Zhōnghuá yǐnshí wénhuà zì dànshēng zhī rì qǐ, jiù miànxiàng shìjiè, biān jìchéng, biān gǎigé, búduàn yǐnjìn xīn yuánsù, zhè yě shì qí chōngmǎn huólì de àomì suǒzài.
lines.en: It can be said that from the day it was born, Chinese food culture has faced the world, inheriting and reforming at the same time and constantly bringing in new elements; this is also the secret of its vitality.

sentences.text: 中国文化的核心是一个“和”字。
“和”包含“中和”“和谐”之意。
“中和”的意思就是折中、调和性质不同的事物。
先秦至唐代，中国采用分餐式方式就餐。

texts.title: 课文
texts.original:
钱小奇养了3只猫。大黄原本是只流浪猫，那天，淋着大雨来钱小奇家拜访，下完雨就不走了。见多识广的大黄虽有流浪史，却很有教养，它既不懒惰，也不嘴馋，天天趴在窗台上晒太阳，一副知足常乐的样子。每次钱小奇出门回来，它都恭恭敬敬地在门口迎接，不失君子风度。白白是个男孩儿，嗅觉灵敏，动作敏捷，快活而好动。钱小奇一回家，它就扑上来，亲热地撞主人的腿，还要把钱小奇和他带回来的东西统统闻一遍。喜儿是个人见人爱的女孩儿，每天大部分时间都在整理自己的毛发，把自己梳理得漂亮而迷人。
钱小奇是个模范饲养员，每天早起第一件事就是伺候猫：清洁猫舍，喂水，喂饭。他虽然工作繁忙，但每天最急切盼望的就是回家开门的那一刻——大黄和白白在门口等候他，喜儿则毫无例外地站在远处，用凝视表达着它深沉的热情。
钱小奇很好奇，自己不在家时猫在做什么？那么长时间，猫们多无聊，会不会忧郁得生病？为了弄清楚这事，他在家里安了个摄像头，监视猫的一举一动。很快，他发现这个不能移动的摄像头有缺陷，拍下的很多镜头都是空的，于是，他增加了设备，并决定自力更生安装一套尖端玩意儿。他边钻研边安装，经过三个多月的努力，安装好的设备不仅能够对猫的动态进行抓拍并储存下图像，钱小奇在外面时还能通过互联网遥控摄像头，对家里的猫进行即时监控，同时能通过操纵、移动摄像头，跟踪到家里的任何一个角落。
通过对大量数据和图片进行分析，钱小奇发现，这三只猫大多数时间都在睡觉。除了睡觉，猫们的行动很有规律，以其中一只猫为例，它每天下午两点左右吃饭喝水，时间误差平均不到5分钟。更有趣的是，每次回家时，守在门口的大黄和白白也不是长时间在门口等他，而是在屋里该干吗干吗，听到主人的脚步声和钥匙响后，才会跑到门口来迎接。
这套系统除了帮钱小奇了解了猫的踪迹以外，还帮过钱小奇不少忙。一次，他在办公室上网遥控摄像头，找到了掉在家里桌子下的钱包。如今，只要家里稍有动静，操作系统就能将图像记录下来，并把拍下的照片即时发到他的邮箱里“报警”。
这是一套多么有用的远程遥控家庭安全机器人啊。
